chapters.title: Chapter 51: Savior!
paragraphs: "This is messed up..." Jonas’ voice was heavy, filled with indignation. He knew he would die before he could even begin his journey.
Terrence and Aurora shared the same thought.
But then, something happened.
Clank... Clank... Clank!
Pssh!
Several smoke grenades rolled across the ground, hissing as thick clouds erupted. None of them had noticed the grenades until the smoke began to spread, swallowing the garbage field in gray mist.
Terrence blinked in confusion.’What’s going on?’
Out of nowhere, a figure emerged. She was clad in a familiar uniform.
"That’s..." Terrence’s eyes widened. He recognized it instantly, it was the Survivor Gear given to all Foreign Survivors transported from Earth.
The figure was a woman, carrying hatchets in both hands, with several more strapped across her back. She was clearly prepared for battle.
With a single strike, she cleaved through one of the Hounds. Her blow landed on the weakest point of its design, the chest. And just like that, the machine collapsed instantly.
The remaining Hounds turned, but another figure was already upon them. His weapon wasn’t an advanced blade, but it pierced the head of a Hound so efficiently!
Needless to say, they were Kai and Claire.
Claire’s Talent granted her immense physical strength, while Kai’s physique had already reached a D‐ rating. His muscles carried enough power to punish the Hounds directly.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Hound (E) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +200 Experience Points ]
The notification surprised Terrence a bit, but he confirmed that one of the Hounds he had damaged was destroyed!

The remaining mechanical beasts tried to regroup, but Kai raised his revolver and fired. His shots were precise, each one striking critical points. At the same time, several more survivors arrived, suppressing the enemy units with coordinated fire.
In seconds, the machines lay in pieces, their red optics fading to black!
They won!
Terrence didn’t know Kai and the others, and Kai didn’t know him either. Still, they were all human, and they shared a common enemy.
More importantly, the three of them wore the Survivor Gear unique to Foreign Survivors like themselves. That alone was enough to create a simple bond.

"There’s a shelter here... Let’s move before the artillery starts focusing on us," Kai said curtly. He didn’t waste time with introductions, simply turning and leading the way. After all, the smoke wouldn’t last forever...
Terrence and the two followed without hesitation as they glanced at the group of people carrying the Hounds back with them, probably to erase their traces.
Under the cover of the smoke grenades, they slipped into a narrow passage hidden beneath heaps of scrap.
Inside the tunnel, there was a faint glow of emergency lamps that guided them deeper underground.
Claire finally broke the silence.
"You’re entering Haven‐45," she said...
"I’m Claire, and our shelter leader is that guy, Kai."
Terrence nodded while still catching his breath. "We didn’t know there was a shelter here... We came from Haven‐15."
His tone carried both relief and sorrow. Aurora and Jonas quickly introduced themselves as well, while Kai remained silent, listening to their conversation.

As they descended further, the differences became obvious. Haven‐45 was in poor condition compared to Haven‐15. The walls were patched with scavenged metal sheets, the corridors were narrow and uneven.

The air also smelled faintly of rust and damp earth. Yet, despite its flaws, it was already a good hideout. Being underground made it far harder for the machines to detect, despite having no jammers like Haven-15.
Aurora’s curiosity broke through her exhaustion. "Right... There’s a battle going on. Are there only two of you Foreign Survivors here?"
Claire shook her head. "No... There are a few more."

Terrence gently nodded. "How about the Augmented Humans here? Since the Mech Siege is ongoing, the System says shelters will be targeted soon. To survive, I think we need the number of Augmented Humans to be high."
Claire gave a wry smile. "There are no Augmented Humans here."
The words struck Terrence like a hammer. He had assumed she was hiding something with that smile, but her bluntness left no room for doubt.
Haven‐45 truly had no Augmented Humans. That explained the patched walls, the improvised defenses, and the weary faces of survivors moving through the corridors.

Still, Terrence couldn’t help but think she might be keeping secrets. In Haven‐15, Augmented Humans had been the backbone of their defense. Without them, how could Haven‐45 possibly stand against the siege?
For now, however, Claire simply gestured for them to rest. Medics arrived, tending to their injuries immediately...
Jonas winced as his arm was cleaned and bandaged, while Aurora sighed in relief as her cuts were treated.
Terrence just sat quietly with his revolver resting on his lap, his mind still replaying the fall of Haven‐15.
Soon, food was brought to them. The rations were simple, sliced meatloaf and instant noodles...
’Did they have extra Food Giftpacks?’
The three exchanged glances but didn’t question it for long... It was already a feast. They ate quickly, as they felt hungry from that smell.
Of course, they were treated well, but Terrence knew it wasn’t just kindness. Haven‐45 probably needed information, and the three survivors from Haven‐15 had plenty to share.
In any case, they had to prove that they deserve to stay in this shelter.
Just as the three began to relax, the ground trembled.
Boom!
A low rumble echoed through the tunnels, followed by a violent shake that sent dust raining from the ceiling.
Plates clattered as the survivors instinctively braced themselves.
"Earthquake?" Aurora gasped, clutching Jonas’ arm.
But they soon heard someone reporting the situation. "Artillery! They’ve shifted fire toward us!"
Terrence’s heart sank. Haven‐45 was being targeted!
Soon, Kai made his move and confirmed that the shells were detonating across the surface, tearing apart the surroundings of the shelter.
Thankfully, the underground depth spared them from direct hits, but the concussions were powerful enough to rattle the entire structure.

Kai thought for a moment before he shouted... "Stay calm! They haven’t locked onto our exact position yet... they could just be trying to force someone out, make us panic and flee, so they can mark the shelter’s location!"

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Unexpected Move
paragraphs: ’This...’
Terrence clenched his fist. He was nervous right now...
’Is this really a safe place?’

He wasn’t exactly sure about the extent of his Talent. His Pathfinder could certainly help him intuitively find a safe place, but it was not omnipotent... Perhaps the safety he felt was just for a few days, hours, or even minutes.
Then, as he heard Kai trying to calm everyone, he couldn’t help but feel more worried since he might just be telling this to avoid making everyone panic.
It wouldn’t be surprising if the spider-like artillery would continue their bombardment until the garbage field was flattened.
Boom!
The bombardment rattled the shelter again, and more dust started falling from the ceiling.
’It’s getting stronger...’Terrence thought as he also noticed that the residents or survivors here would flinch at every blast. Without a doubt, their nerves had already stretched thin.
Then, as Terrence was considering what to do next, four figures stepped forward from the crowd of survivors and approached the Shelter Leader, Kai.
"Hmm?"
Kai recognized them vaguely, two Boiler Room Operators with their darkened gloves and two from the Sanitation Crew who had dirty orange helmet on.
One of the Operators spoke as he looked at Kai.
"Leader... there’s no other choice. We’ll create a diversion."
The second Operator added quickly. "We’ll run in different directions and draw their fire. Give us smoke grenades and guns, we’ll make enough noise to pull the artillery away from here."
Kai’s eyes narrowed as he didn’t expect this kind of volunteers...

He had only been in Haven‐45 for a few days, barely enough time to learn names. He didn’t know these men and women well, but he knew their work kept the shelter alive. To send them out was to send them to their deaths.
"There must be another way," Kai muttered as he considered their other options... "I can’t just let you throw your lives away." He added.
But the woman from the Sanitation Crew stepped forward...
"Leader, if we stay here, we’ll all die. If we go out, maybe we can buy you time... or maybe we can also survive. But if we do nothing, Haven‐45 will collapse. I can’t let that happen!"
Her partner clenched his fists, before turning to her and held her hands.
"We’ve seen the shells tearing the surface apart. If they lock onto us, it’s over. Let us go. At least then, we’ll have a chance to change the outcome."

The Operators nodded in agreement. There was desperation burning in their eyes. "We’re not soldiers, but we can run fast. We can make noise, so just give us the tools. Smoke grenades, guns... anything. If we’re lucky, we’ll live long enough to escape..."
Around them, murmurs spread. Some survivors shook their heads, unwilling to sacrifice more lives. Others looked away, unable to meet the eyes of the four volunteers.
Terrence, on the other hand, was torn between admiration and dread. This was surely a tough decision.
Soon, Aurora whispered beside him. "They’ll die out there..."
Jonas nodded. "Maybe they’ll save us that way."
Kai had to pause for a moment. He had taken command of Haven‐45 only days ago, and already the weight of leadership felt too heavy...
Right now, he couldn’t afford to lose people, but he couldn’t ignore their determination either. Although he might have other plans, it was also not a guarantee.
Boom!
The artillery thundered again, rattling the shelter...
Finally, Kai exhaled sharply.

"Fine. Take what you need. But listen... stay alive as long as you can. Don’t throw yourselves away. If you manage to escape, take these canned goods. Survive until rescue comes. Don’t waste your chance."
Everything happened so quickly...
The four accepted the weapons, smoke grenades, and supplies that they could carry to the point that they wouldn’t hinder their movements.
Soon, they slipped out through different entrances, vanishing into the chaos above.
In the underground chamber, survivors crowded around the periscopes, watching anxiously.
They were anticipating whether these four would actually succeed or not.
Just like that, they waited for the noise, the smoke, the distraction that would draw the artillery away.
But what they saw instead froze their blood.
The four didn’t fire their guns.
They didn’t shout or make noise. Instead, they hurled their smoke grenades directly above the shelter’s location, as if marking it as a target.
"Impossible..." Russel, who had known the four for several years, whispered. His face was pale in shock.
Through the periscopes, they saw the four figures darting swiftly toward the sewers, disappearing into the shadows. They hadn’t gone to draw fire, they had gone to escape!
Kai’s fists tightened, his voice breaking with fury. "They betrayed us..."
Boom!
The ground shook violently as shells detonated closer!
At this point, the concussions were already rattling the walls.
More dust poured from the ceiling, and soon, they noticed some cracks spreading across the walls.
Claire’s eyes widened in horror. "They... they wanted us to be destroyed!"
Ralph then slammed his fist against the wall, rage boiling in his chest. "Cowards! They used us as bait!"
Terrence also felt worried... Even without Spirit Points to reactivate his talent, he could somehow tell that Haven‐45 was no longer safe.
However, Kai hadn’t given up just yet.
The betrayal had left them exposed, and the artillery was focusing on their location.
Still, he had prepared several contingency plans for the Mech Siege.
From collapsing the tunnels, creating fire traps, raining with bullets, and others... But now only one remained viable. Plan D.
It was the most desperate measure, destroying their entrances and escaping through the hidden underground route.
Few knew of it... Ralph, Victor, Claire, Russel, Augustine, and a handful of others.
The Elder, the previous leader, had once tried to kill Kai and his group by detonating explosives in his chamber. At first, it seemed like a desperate act of vengeance for his sons.
He killed himself and destroyed the room, even if the blast hadn’t damaged the shelter much. But Kai had always been suspicious of this move.
He ordered the chamber cleared, and the truth was revealed... Apparently, the Elder had been hiding an escape route.
Needless to say, only those involved in uncovering it knew of its existence. After all, Kai didn’t want it to be revealed unless necessary.
"Forget about the traitors. Proceed with Plan D..." Kai commanded, just as he noticed the areas the four traitors had fled into were now swarming with Sentinels.

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Escape Route
paragraphs: Russel, Claire, Ralph, and others immediately informed the others about the Plan D!
The order was given, and no one hesitated. After all, none of them has a better plan!
"Move!"
It didn’t take that long before the plan was set into motion.
"Forget about the traitors. Proceed with Plan D... Quick! We don’t know how long our shelter can hold," Russel said as he clapped his hands.
The survivors moved quickly. They didn’t even bring any of their things and just quickly used the passage leader to the underground base.
They also didn’t want the enemies to have the chance to raid their shelter... so, Kai gave another order. As soon as everyone relocated, he actually collapsed the entrances of their shelter.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The thunder of destruction echoed through the underground, sealing off the paths that the Sentinels had already begun to swarm.
From the outside, it seemed as if the Artillery had succeeded and destroyed their base.
Just like that, dust and smoke filled the air, but the remaining residents were already in the secret tunnel as they moved to their last underground chamber.
They were guided by dim lamps, but it was enough to make them feel safer. Then, they continued walking for about ten minutes before reaching their destination.
"We’ve arrived..."
"This is a lot more spacious than I thought..."
"B-but there’s nothing here."
"I never thought that we had another secret tunnel here..."
"This is also my first time seeing this."
"I wonder what the end of this chamber is."
"It must be connected to the city or something."
They were all surprised at first, but none of them complained about the condition of the shelter.
"Don’t worry... This is just temporary until the Siege is over." Kai reassured the group as he looked around.
Previously, Haven-45 only had forty residents.

When Kai and the four others arrived, their population reached forty-five. However, after the death of the three previous leaders, their three guards, the elder, one unlucky scout, and the four traitors, there were only 33 residents...
Now, with Terrence, Aurora, and Jonas, they have 36 people left.
There weren’t many of them, but it made their temporary shelter seem small.
"Kai... You really did well ordering us to clean up that room." Victor whispered.
"That’s true... I thought you just wanted us to gather rocks or something." Claire added.
Kai chuckled at this and replied.
"I have Keen Sense Skill, remember? It gave me a hint on what to do."
He could understand their reaction as he also felt worried that his order at that time was useless.
At first, the collapsed chamber seemed like nothing more than rubble and wasted effort. But a narrow shaft had been revealed after a few hours of work.
The Elder had hidden it well, perhaps intending to use it himself, perhaps to keep it secret until the right moment.
Still, the place was dirty... There was the stench of stagnant water and rusted pipes filling their lungs.
The walls were slick with moisture, and the faint trickle of sewage could also be heard. It wasn’t a place meant for habitation, but it was hidden, and that was all that mattered.
They set up a temporary camp in a wider chamber where broken pipes and collapsed stone created a crude shelter.
Thankfully, Kai had plenty of Tents prepared that they could temporarily use.
As for the food and water, that was not a problem with Kai’s Talent...
"We just have to wait it out..." Kai muttered.
They knew the Mech Siege lasted seventy‐two hours, and more than a day had already passed. If they could remain undetected for two more days, they might survive.
At this point, there wasn’t much Kai could do, so he decided to get to know Terrence, Jonas, and Aurora better...
They had come from Haven‐15, a shelter that had already fallen.
Kai knew little about them, only that they had survived against odds that should have killed them. If he was to lead effectively, he needed to understand their Talents.
He approached them as they sat together near the edge of the chamber.
They had just finished setting up their tents when they noticed him approach.
"Thank you for sheltering us... and for the tents and food. We will do our best not to be a burden to you." Terrence said.
He looked weary, but he still approached Kai calmly...
Jonas and Aurora also stood up and introduced themselves.

Kai crouched before them. "You three are new here. If we’re going to survive, I need to know what you can do. Your Talents. Your strengths. Everything. That way, I can assign you some work, especially if you have production talent or combat skills."

Terrence hesitated, then nodded. "My Talent is Pathfinder. It lets me sense safe places, guides me instinctively. But it’s not perfect. It costs Spirit Points to activate, and I don’t have many left. Right now, I can’t use it again."
Kai’s eyes narrowed with interest. "A Talent that finds safety..."

Jonas spoke next. "Mine is Iron Stomach... It is a Superior Rank. I can digest a lot of things, including glass and metal. Normally, it won’t have any other effect aside from alleviating my hunger, but there are some items I eat that give me a special buff..."
"What? Isn’t that an incredible talent?" Kai muttered. The others who were secretly listening were also shocked at this.
"If I can trade this for a Combat Talent, I will do so." Jonas replied.
Then, Aurora finally spoke... and she didn’t seem happy about her talent at all.
"My talent is called Plant Enthusiast... For now, it helps me grow plants and crops a little faster. But don’t expect too much. It’s just Uncommon Rank." She weakly said.

"That’s still impressive. I’m sure all of your talents will be useful to us. As long as we work together, we can survive this." Kai was not great with speech or words. However, he genuinely believed that their talents would be useful, and they felt it.
Soon, Kai learned about the Augmented Humans and the existence of the Spirit Stimulants that could restore 10 Spirit Points!

Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
The thunder of destruction echoed through the underground, sealing off the paths that the Sentinels had already begun to swarm.
From the outside, it seemed as if the Artillery had succeeded and destroyed their base.
Just like that, dust and smoke filled the air, but the remaining residents were already in the secret tunnel as they moved to their last underground chamber.
They were guided by dim lamps, but it was enough to make them feel safer.
Then, they continued walking for about ten minutes before reaching their destination.
"We’ve arrived..."
"This is a lot more spacious than I thought..."
"B-but there’s nothing here."
"I never thought that we had another secret tunnel here..."
"This is also my first time seeing this."
"I wonder what the end of this chamber is."
"It must be connected to the city or something."
They were all surprised at first, but none of them complained about the condition of the shelter.
"Don’t worry...
This is just temporary until the Siege is over." Kai reassured the group as he looked around.
Previously, Haven-45 only had forty residents.
When Kai and the four others arrived, their population reached forty-five.
However, after the death of the three previous leaders, their three guards, the elder, one unlucky scout, and the four traitors, there were only 33 residents...
Now, with Terrence, Aurora, and Jonas, they have 36 people left.
There weren’t many of them, but it made their temporary shelter seem small.
"Kai...
You really did well ordering us to clean up that room." Victor whispered.
"That’s true...
I thought you just wanted us to gather rocks or something." Claire added.
Kai chuckled at this and replied.
"I have Keen Sense Skill, remember?
It gave me a hint on what to do."
He could understand their reaction as he also felt worried that his order at that time was useless.
At first, the collapsed chamber seemed like nothing more than rubble and wasted effort.
But a narrow shaft had been revealed after a few hours of work.
The Elder had hidden it well, perhaps intending to use it himself, perhaps to keep it secret until the right moment.
Still, the place was dirty...
There was the stench of stagnant water and rusted pipes filling their lungs.
The walls were slick with moisture, and the faint trickle of sewage could also be heard.
It wasn’t a place meant for habitation, but it was hidden, and that was all that mattered.
They set up a temporary camp in a wider chamber where broken pipes and collapsed stone created a crude shelter.
Thankfully, Kai had plenty of Tents prepared that they could temporarily use.
As for the food and water, that was not a problem with Kai’s Talent...
"We just have to wait it out..." Kai muttered.
They knew the Mech Siege lasted seventy‐two hours, and more than a day had already passed.
If they could remain undetected for two more days, they might survive.
At this point, there wasn’t much Kai could do, so he decided to get to know Terrence, Jonas, and Aurora better...
They had come from Haven‐15, a shelter that had already fallen.
Kai knew little about them, only that they had survived against odds that should have killed them.
If he was to lead effectively, he needed to understand their Talents.
He approached them as they sat together near the edge of the chamber.
They had just finished setting up their tents when they noticed him approach.
"Thank you for sheltering us... and for the tents and food.
We will do our best not to be a burden to you." Terrence said.
He looked weary, but he still approached Kai calmly...
Jonas and Aurora also stood up and introduced themselves.
Kai crouched before them.
"You three are new here.
If we’re going to survive, I need to know what you can do.
Your Talents.
Your strengths.
Everything.
That way, I can assign you some work, especially if you have production talent or combat skills."
Terrence hesitated, then nodded.
"My Talent is Pathfinder.
It lets me sense safe places, guides me instinctively.
But it’s not perfect.
It costs Spirit Points to activate, and I don’t have many left.
Right now, I can’t use it again."
Kai’s eyes narrowed with interest.
"A Talent that finds safety..."
Jonas spoke next.
"Mine is Iron Stomach...
It is a Superior Rank.
I can digest a lot of things, including glass and metal.
Normally, it won’t have any other effect aside from alleviating my hunger, but there are some items I eat that give me a special buff..."
"What?
Isn’t that an incredible talent?" Kai muttered.
The others who were secretly listening were also shocked at this.
"If I can trade this for a Combat Talent, I will do so." Jonas replied.
Then, Aurora finally spoke... and she didn’t seem happy about her talent at all.
"My talent is called Plant Enthusiast...
For now, it helps me grow plants and crops a little faster.
But don’t expect too much.
It’s just Uncommon Rank." She weakly said.
"That’s still impressive.
I’m sure all of your talents will be useful to us.
As long as we work together, we can survive this." Kai was not great with speech or words.
However, he genuinely believed that their talents would be useful, and they felt it.
Soon, Kai learned about the Augmented Humans and the existence of the Spirit Stimulants that could restore 10 Spirit Points!

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Competition
paragraphs: When Kai asked for information about Haven‐15, Terrence revealed the existence of Augmented Humans first. After all, he hadn’t found any in this shelter.

"They’re enhanced fighters, stronger than normal survivors. I’m pretty sure they’ve undergone various gene modifications. They led the defense in the shelter, but even they couldn’t stop the Sentinels forever. The machines overwhelmed us..."

Kai could tell that much and confirmed the system’s message that having a high-level Survivor like those Augmented Humans might bring more harm to low-level Survivors like them. Since the Mech Siege was affected by the population and the average level!

In any case, Jonas added, "We also had Spirit Stimulants. They restored Spirit Points. It only restored 10 Spirit Points, but it was a good effect. Without them, we wouldn’t have lasted as long as we did."
Kai appreciated this information, and just like that, he also shared about his Talent related to gift packs. Of course, they had no idea that he could use it infinitely and at no cost.
For now, they believed he had to pay with Spirit Points, even without him saying anything.
Then, the hours dragged on. The survivors rationed food while they listened to the distant rumble of artillery above.
Still, every sound echoed through the chamber, and every drip of water from the ceiling reminded them of their precarious existence.
Furthermore, the damp air carried the stench of rust and sewage, and it was pressing on their nerves.
But none of them were giving up. Kai enforced strict discipline among them... There should be no loud noises and no unnecessary movement.
He also assigned patrols within the tunnels, especially near the small open path that led to the unknown, perhaps the city.
So no one was allowed to wander too far.
They had to remain undetected until the event was over...
After all, the Sentinels were relentless, but they were machines, bound to patterns. If they stayed hidden, perhaps the machines would pass them by.

Just like that, two days passed slowly. The survivors endured hunger, exhaustion, and the constant dread of discovery. Yet they remained hidden as their presence was also masked by the collapsed tunnels and the stench of the sewers.
Finally, the seventy‐two hours ended. The movement of the Sentinels ceased and silence returned. The Mech Siege was over.
Needless to say, their relief was confirmed by the system message that appeared next!
[ Congratulations! Global Event Completed! ]
[ Hostile Operation: Mech Siege - SUCCESS ]
[ Duration: 72 Hours ]
[ Status: Shelter Damaged but NOT Destroyed ]
[ Survivors Remaining: 36 ]
[ Objective Achieved: Defend designated shelter against mechanical assault ]
[ Rewards Granted: ]
- Experience Points: +1,000
- Survivor’s Medal x2
- Treasure Chest (Materials) x5
- New Title: "Siege Breaker"
[ Hidden Quests Completed! ]
[Cross-Shelter Rescue] - Saved survivors from another shelter.
Reward: +2,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x1 [Zero Casualties] - Maintained zero deaths among the shelter’s residents during the siege.
Reward: +2,500 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x1 [Against All Odds] - Survived high‐level artillery bombardment beyond the current shelter level.
Reward: +3,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x1 [Unexpected Threat] - Endured enemy forces not part of the calibrated siege (attracted by traitors, and rescued survivors).
Reward: +2,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x1 [Betrayal Survived] - Endured sabotage from within the shelter and still prevented collapse. Reward: +3,000 EXP, Survivor’s Medal x1
[ Total Hidden Quest Rewards: +12,500 EXP, Survivor’s Medals x5, Treasure Chests x5 ]
[ New Title Acquired: "Siege Breaker" ]
[ Siege Breaker - Grants increased Health and Spirit Recovery. ]
The glowing system text faded, leaving the chamber in stunned silence. For a moment, no one spoke.
Then Claire broke into a cheer, her voice echoed through the chamber.
"We did it! Haven‐45 survived!" She raised her fists, her relief spilling out in laughter.
The tension that had gripped her for days finally dissipated, and others couldn’t help but smile at her energy.
Ralph stared at the message... "Whoa... I got five plust two treasure chests... five medals... and all that experience? This is amazing."
His amazement was genuine, even his voice was trembling between disbelief and excitement. "I really thought we’re going down here, but instead... we’re stronger than ever."
Victor chuckled, shaking his head as if confirming the impossible. "It’s real. The system doesn’t lie. We actually pulled it off."
His laughter spread, easing the heavy air, and a few survivors joined in nervously...
Kai, however, stood still, his gaze still locked on the notifications. He felt the surge of power coursing through him, the unmistakable shift as his level climbed.
Level 9!
There were several more notifications in front of him, but he didn’t focus on them just yet.
He exhaled slowly, as he turned his attention to others...
It seemed that Terrence, Jonas, and Aurora didn’t look too good.
’Right... Their shelter was destroyed. Even if they survived, the reward must’ve been affected...’Kai thought, and he was actually correct!
Nonetheless, the chamber’s mood shifted quickly.
Of course, if he noticed this, the others found it out. Still, Claire tried to keep spirits high, rallying the group with her cheer.
"Now that the event is over, we can finally get out of here. Of course, we still have to be careful, but it should be possible now."
Then, just as the survivors began to settle, the system activated again.
[ System Update: New Feature Activated! ]
[ Survivor Leaderboard:
Only Survivors who reach Level 10 will be listed.
Rankings will be updated once per month.
The Top 3 Survivors will receive exclusive rewards at each update. ]
[ Reminder: Reduced A.I. Army Activity!
Enemy patrols will decrease temporarily.
Survivors are advised to use the coming days wisely.
This is a rare opportunity to recover, rebuild, and prepare before full activity resumes. ]
"What in the world?" Kai was shocked.
The chamber fell silent as well. A leaderboard meant competition, recognition, and power, but it also meant exposure!
Still, he also knew that he had no other choice, as he needed to compete for the rewards given to the Top 3 Survivors to stay ahead!
At the same time, the Foreign Survivors across the continent, especially those with high‐grade Talents who had endured the Mech Siege with relative ease, felt a surge of anticipation.
The announcement of the Survivor Leaderboard that promised unknown rewards for the Top Survivors, and the prospect of monthly competition, ignited their excitement!

chapters.title: Chapter 55: The Rank 1
paragraphs: Across the continent, the system’s new announcement rang out like a bell... The Survivors everywhere froze as the system’s message appeared before their eyes.
[ System Update: Survivor Leaderboard Activated!]
[ Requirement: Level 10+]
[ Monthly Rankings with Rewards for Top 3 Survivors.]
For some, it was something they wanted to look forward to.
But for others, it felt like a threat. After all, their names would be published in the Leaderboard, and none of them were sure whether it was a good thing or a bad thing just yet.
Many of them didn’t want to expose their abilities after all.
In the wreckage of Haven‐32, Renji crouched beside the remains of a fallen Sentinel. His hands were streaked with blood and grease, but he was uninjured.
The shelter around him was nothing but rubble. There were corpses of his previous companions buried beneath steel beams, but he was the only one left alive.
"This..."
The system’s message hovered before him, casting a pale glow across the broken rifle he was repairing.
Renji muttered, "Leaderboard... Level 10... rewards for the top three. So the system wants us to fight each other now..."
His mind wasn’t just considering the glory of being listed at the top.
He was also thinking that this might be a chance for murderers like him to eliminate the high-ranking Survivors to get their ranking higher.
Indeed, he was a prisoner prior to the Global Apocalypse!
Because of that, he knew very well that this leaderboard could also be a problem.
Clank...
He then pried open the Sentinel’s chest cavity, pulling free a humming energy core.
"C-Grade Sentinels are the best." Renji muttered as he looked at the core.
Then, after a few moments, he used the very same core to power up the rifle he had just repaired a few minutes ago!
"Perfect," he whispered as he slid the core into place.
Just like that, the weapon vibrated, and it was alive again. He smirked. "Now... I should probably find a new shelter while the A.I. Army’s activity has reduced."

He then looked at the glowing message again... At this point, he already knew that he couldn’t just let the others take the rewards for the Top 3 Survivors. He must obtain it even if it means that he could be targeted.
"Level 10 is just the start. I’ll make sure my name is carved into that list."
Renji then stood and tested the rifle on a nearby rock.
Thud!
A faint pulse of blue light shot into the rubble, scorching stone.
It wasn’t enough to blast the stone or drill a hole in it, but Renji knew that it would have a different result if used on humans!
Meanwhile, deep in the forests, Mei sprinted through the undergrowth.
She was not running from Sentinels or any other A.I. Soldiers but from humans!
Indeed, behind her were several men shouting crude threats, and they just wanted to capture her!
Their laughter could even be heard echoing through the trees.
They had survived the siege, too, but desperation had twisted them into predators. Now that the Mech Siege was over, they thought that they could take advantage of her!
"That tree’s big enough... I can do this." Mei muttered as she hurriedly slid behind the tree. She pressed her palm against the bark, and her Talent, Living Camouflage, activated.
Her skin shifted, her clothes darkened, and within seconds she blended seamlessly into the trunk.
After a few seconds, the men rushed past, cursing. One spat, "Where’d she go? She was right here!"
Another one cursed as he also couldn’t find traces of the woman,
"Doesn’t matter. We’ll find her. She won’t get far."
Mei remained silent as her body went perfectly still.
She could remain hidden indefinitely with her form merging with natural cover. But she was no passive prey. If she were found, she was willing to fight to the death!
Slowly, she drew a dagger and waited...
However, none of them actually noticed her hiding spot.
Instead, the men disappeared deeper into the forest, unaware she was watching them from only a few feet away.
"They’re stupid, huh..." Mei muttered as she looked in the direction from which she came, the Haven-11...
With a sigh, Mei stepped out from the tree, her form returning to normal.
"I should find a new shelter... or at least a proper hiding place," she said, clenching her fist.
She must admit that this apocalypse was unbearable. There were times she wanted to give up, hoping that death might return her to Earth. But she knew that was unlikely to happen.
’Someone... I hope I can at least find someone I know here,’Mei prayed silently.
She needed someone she could trust, someone unlike the men who had chased her moments ago.

As she thought of this, a figure came to mind, her most reliable co-worker from the company. If he were here, she was certain he would thrive. He was talented, resourceful, and perhaps even capable of hacking the A.I.’s systems if he had the resources.
"Senior Kai..." Mei muttered as she left the forest.

At the same time that this was happening, in the ruins of Haven‐19, Arjun finally came out of the rubble, his body covered in cuts and bruises. His shelter was already gone, reduced to ash... He was the only one left alive.
It means that his reward was lower than that of many others.
The system’s notification hovered before him...
"Level 10... rewards for the top three. "So that’s the game now."

Arjun’s Talent, Endurance Surge, allowed him to push his body beyond its limits when wounded. The more blood he shed, the stronger he became. It was a brutal gift, one that had carried him through the siege when others fell.
"I will be the first one to reach this Level 10—"
As he said this, an update occurred in the Survivor Leaderboard!
[ Survivor Leaderboard ]
[ Ranking List
1. Kai ( Level 10 )
2. Unavailable.
3. Unavailable.
10. Unavailable.
"What?! How? Why is he so fast?!" Arjun was shocked, and of course, the shock wasn’t his alone.
Across the continent, survivors stared at the glowing list, stunned.
The first name had already appeared, Kai. He had reached Level 10 before anyone else!

chapters.title: Chapter 56: The High Level Survivors
paragraphs: Arjun had just successfully passed Level 5.

He had struggled for days, not knowing how to bypass the level until he discovered the existence of the Energy Core. Seeing that someone had already reached Level 10, he couldn’t help but feel amazed.
"What?! How? Why is he so fast?!"

His body trembled, not from wounds but from disbelief that he had been surpassed. He had clawed his way out of Haven‐19’s ruins, convinced he would be the first to reach Level 10. Yet the system had already crowned another.
The shock wasn’t his alone. Across the continent, survivors stared at the glowing list, stunned. The first name had already appeared... Kai.
"Who the heck is this guy?"
"He reached Level 10 before anyone else. Maybe he has an Epic Grade... or even a Legendary Grade Talent."
"This is too unfair... I only have an Uncommon Talent. I should’ve selected Zombie Outbreak."
"I barely survived the Mech Siege. I almost died a few times, and I’m only Level 3. Just what did he do?"
"He must be very lucky... Maybe the shelter he entered had many Augmented Humans."
"Did he drink multiple types of Gene Enhancement Serum?"
Everyone had different reactions as they saw the Leaderboard.
First of all, the existence of the Leaderboard itself was something none of them had expected to see...

But now, with its existence, many couldn’t help but feel as though this was truly some kind of game, and someone out there was enjoying the sight of them struggling to survive, or even being killed by the machines.

At the same time, in the rubble of Haven‐32, Renji also froze at the sight of the Leaderboard. His smirk had already faded. He had just been planning how to level up quickly when someone had already reached Level 10.
"Kai..." he muttered.
Although he hadn’t seen the man yet, he already knew he had a rival, a target he must defeat. Renji sighed as he slung the rifle across his back.
"Maybe he’s slaughtering Sentinels faster than anyone else. Or... maybe he’s killing survivors."

He wasn’t sure how Kai had done it, but he knew he had to act quickly. Renji could only trust his Mechanical Expert Talent and the high‐tech rifle in his hands if he wanted to compete. Of course, another option crossed his mind.
"Maybe I should just hunt him down eventually." The thought didn’t frighten him. It thrilled him.
Still, deep in the forest, Mei froze as the system’s message burned before her eyes.
Kai.
She paused at the sight of the name. There was no surname since the system had stripped them all away, leaving only first names. But still... it could be him.

"Senior Kai..." she whispered, her dagger trembling in her grip. The co‐worker she remembered had been reliable, resourceful, someone she trusted more than anyone else. Could this Rank 1 survivor truly be the same man?

Her heart pounded. If it was him, then he was alive... thriving, even. But if it wasn’t... then Kai was just another predator, stronger than the rest, and now every survivor would either want to ally with him or hunt him.
Mei pressed her back against the tree as her camouflage faded. "Please... let it be him."
Far to the north, in the remains of Haven‐13, a group of survivors huddled around the fire that gave them warmth as they read the message about the Leaderboard’s update.
"Level 10 already?!" One man with blond hair was shocked. He was Darren, once a well‐known politician back on Earth. Now, he was the acting leader of a small group of foreign survivors.
"That guy reached it first... I knew we should’ve killed all those residents. Now the Sentinels wiped them out, and we got nothing. We should’ve been the ones gaining experience points."
His words rang true, and none in his group spoke against him.

Still, they remembered the argument that had nearly split them days ago. Darren had insisted that the ordinary residents of Haven‐13 were nothing but expendable "NPCs," useless in the long run. He had wanted to slaughter them, harvest the points, and rise faster.
But his companions had stopped him. Lena, once an idol, had argued that the residents might give missions or rewards later.

She had played games before, after all. She was backed by Kevin, who possessed a Knight Talent and believed they needed allies, not corpses. Even Brent, the one with the Digger Talent and very important in their group, had sided against Darren, insisting that killing innocents would only weaken their humanity.

Now, as the memory of the Mech Siege lingered, their decision felt hollow. The residents had died anyway, crushed beneath Sentinel fire... They could only remember their screams echoing in the burning shelter.
Furthermore, with all those deaths, it had affected the final rewards given to them anyway!
Darren spat into the dirt as he recalled it.
"We wasted our chance. If we’d acted, we’d be closer to Level 10. Instead, some Kai bastard gets the glory. He must’ve received a First Achievement reward."
He knew about First Achievement rewards, since he had obtained two himself. He couldn’t help but feel jealous.
Lena placed a hand on his shoulder. "That’s enough. Regret won’t change the past. We survived, and that’s more than most can say."

Kevin nodded. "We can’t chase ghosts. Haven‐13 is gone. If we want to live, we need to search for another shelter... or maybe build one. Didn’t you say you wanted to lead us? Then start acting like a real leader."
Darren sighed as he listened to them... Then, he turned to Brent, who sat quietly, sharpening a rusted shovel, the tool that defined his Talent.
With the Digger Talent, Brent could carve tunnels and bunkers faster than any ordinary man. As long as he had equipment, he could create shelter from nothing.
"Fine... Let’s not think about the Leaderboard. Let’s leave this place together. Take out your buckets, have a drink!"
As Darren said this, he used his Talent and produced water for everyone...

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Level Up
paragraphs: A few moments ago, Kai remained silent as the survivors around him celebrated.
The system’s messages still hovered before his eyes, each line a reminder of what he had endured over the past three days, and of course, he also noticed what he had gained.
[ Name: Kai
Title: Survivor, Pioneer, Siege Breaker
Level: 9
Health: 710/710
Spirit: 156/156
Physique Rating: D-
Talent: Infinite Gift Pack (SSS)
Active Skills: None
Passive Skills: Keen Sense Lv0, Bio Adaptive Constitution Lv0
Skill Point: 9 ]
Apparently, he got 20 health points more for each level from Level 7 to Level 9, while he gained 2 points for each level in his Spirit Points.
Then, seeing the Skill Points he had saved up, he now felt comfortable using it to level up his set of Skills.
After all, the reason why he didn’t use it up yet was that he felt that the Keen Sense wasn’t really a great skill.
He was worried that it would get easily overshadowed by other possible Gene Skills he’d get, and he might regret using the Skill Points that he’d rarely get.
Furthermore, he thought that it would also automatically level up if used enough. Well, in various games he played before, Skill Mastery was normally quick to level up at first.
However, it seemed that it was too slow in this world’s setting.
"I got some Treasure Chests... I want to try opening them." Claire muttered.
"I also got them. Let’s see." Ralph muttered as they all opened their inventory...
Of course, Kai did the same...
He selected the Treasure Chest icon in the inventory and was asked by the System.
[ Do you want to open the Material Treasure Chest? ]
"Yes..." Kai replied as he selected the option.
The chest then dissolved into motes of light, and raw materials appeared in front of him.
Indeed, they weren’t in his inventory, but they all appeared in front!
[ Material Treasure Chest Opened ]
[ You have obtained the following materials:
Iron Ingots ×5
Copper Ingots ×5
Refined Steel Plates ×5
Woven Fabric Sheets ×10
Leather Bundles ×10
Timber Planks ×10 ]
The Iron Ingots were heavy. They were dark bars, and without a doubt, they were the backbone of weapons, tools, and structural reinforcement.
The Copper Ingots, on the other hand, would be perfect for wiring, fittings, or alloying...
"They’re all raw materials, huh..." Kai muttered as he looked at the Refined Steel Plates. They were polished sheets, strong enough to forge armor or reinforce barricades.
"This feels nice." Kai said as he realized that the Woven Fabric Sheets were coarse but durable, ideal for clothing, tents, or insulation once cut and stitched.
Then, the Leather Bundles carried a musky scent. They were definitely raw hides that could be cured into protective gear or straps.
Finally, the Timber Planks. Without a doubt, this item was either meant for construction, fuel, or makeshift shields.
Around him, Claire also gasped at her own loot, before looking at Kai, who looked satisfied.
"Can we compare what we get?" Claire asked.
They don’t really need to keep their rewards secrets, so everyone just answered.
Apparently, there wasn’t much difference. Everyone had 6 types of loot inside the treasure chest.
Most of them were materials. But the others had stone blocks, rope coils, clay bricks, charcoal, and Claire was even lucky enough to get Linen Rolls!
It was quite interesting as well, since it was as if the system was telling them to gather these items and build their own shelter.
Anyway, their inventory slots were too low and couldn’t really store too much. Because of that, all the items from the Material Treasure Chests would have to be processed soon.
"Alright... Let me level up skills this time..." Victor muttered. His Adaptive Tinkering Skill was crucial to his role as a Mechanic, so he needed to increase it now.
With so many raw materials from the chests, including the salvaged materials from the Sentinels and Hounds, he must level up his skill and start working harder.
Kai followed suit.
However, instead of spending them all, Kai just used three Skill Points to Keen Sense.
Kai focused on his skill menu and selected the plus sign... Well, he can also use voice command, but he decided to just use his fingers instead.
[ Skill Upgrade: Keen Sense is now Level 1 ]
[ Skill Upgrade: Keen Sense is now Level 2 ]
[ Skill Upgrade: Keen Sense is now Level 3 ]
The notifications flashed one after another. At first, he expected only a slight improvement in perception, but the system surprised him.

[ Keen Sense (Level 3): Enhances sight and detection ability. Allows clearer vision in low light and improves awareness of hidden threats. Beyond ordinary perception, this skill enables the detection of faint vibrations, subtle energy fluctuations, and hidden movements within a limited radius. ]
"Now... It really changed." Kai muttered as he noticed that he could finally detect energy fluctuations with this beginner skill.
"I hope there’s a huge change for all Level 3 Skills." Kai muttered as he planned to use another three Skill Points on his second skill.
After just a few moments, he got this result.
[ Skill Upgrade: Bio‐Adaptive Constitution is now Level 3 ]

[ Bio‐Adaptive Constitution (Level 3): The physiology adapts to foreign modifications, preventing rejection, including gene serums of the same type, ensuring seamless integration with synthetic or unfamiliar enhancements. ]
"Ohhh... So even gene serums now?! Cool!" Kai was happy since this was critical.
The Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum he had consumed before was supposedly unable to enhance him anymore. At the very least, he had to wait three more weeks or so.
However, it seemed different now!
Without hesitation, Kai opened his inventory. The familiar golden vial glowed faintly.
It was the Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum he had stored before the Mech Siege. He had kept it safe, waiting for the right moment.
He uncorked it and drank. The bitter liquid burned down his throat, and the system immediately responded.
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum Consumed ]
[ +2,000 Experience Points ]
[ Permanent Stat Increase: Health +5, Spirit +1 ]
"Nice... It worked." Kai muttered in excitement as he confirmed that he was allowed to consume the Serum once again!
It was obviously not enough to level up, so he continued...
[ Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum Consumed ]
[ +10,000 Experience Points ]
[ Permanent Stat Increase: Health +25, Spirit +5 ]
This continued for a few moments as Kai was only sipping a tiny amount...
However, after only consuming half of the gold liquid, a surge of energy hit him like a wave. His body felt a lot stronger!
Then, the final notification that brought him to the Leaderboard appeared.
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 10 ]
[ Health Points +100 ]
[ Spirit Points +2 ]
[ Physique Rating has slightly improved! ]
[ Inventory Slots Expanded: +1 ]

chapters.title: Chapter 58: The Rewards and the Uncertainty
paragraphs: Just as the surge of energy settled in Kai’s body, another notification appeared before his eyes.
[ Congratulations! You are the First Survivor to reach Level 10! ]
This was a familiar notification. When he had reached Level 5 in the past, he had received a similar message.
Back then, the system had granted him Tier 2 Survivor Gear, a durable set of equipment that could actually adapt to his physique.
This time, however, the reward was far greater.
[ Reward Granted: Enhanced Gift Pack Bundle ]

[ Description: A system-forged bundle containing one Enhanced Gift Pack from each category: Energy, Entertainment, Food, Medical, Shelter, Stealth, Survival Tools, Transport, Water, and Weapon. Enhanced Gift Packs provide superior resources compared to their basic versions, offering better items, higher durability, and expanded utility. ]
Kai’s eyes widened.
He had grown familiar with the basic Gift Packs thanks to his SSS Talent, Infinite Gift Pack. But this was different.
These weren’t ordinary bundles. They were enhanced versions!
Just as the description said, they contained far greater resources than anything he had opened before.
His pulse quickened.
’This is perfect timing... Now, I’ll know what’s next.’He mused.

Well, he couldn’t help but feel excited about this. After all, this might be the path of his Talent. Perhaps, in the future, his Infinite Gift Pack could evolve to generate Enhanced Gift Packs instead of the current Basic Gift Pack. It wasn’t possible yet, but the thought filled him with anticipation.
Right now, even if he hadn’t seen the contents yet, he could already imagine how good they’d be.
An Enhanced Food Pack could probably provide supplies that lasted weeks, maybe even delicacies that couldn’t be found before.
An Enhanced Weapon Pack might contain rare armament. Well, a higher caliber gun might also be better, considering how he only got a revolver for the current one.

Even the Entertainment Pack mattered. Kai believed morale was as vital as food in long‐term survival. He remembered the group of survivors who had betrayed Haven‐45... They were definitely not hungry, but they had been unhappy, restless, and disconnected.
Perhaps, with better Entertainment Packs, people would feel a sense of belonging and stability in the shelter he wanted to build.
And the Transport Pack... Kai’s lips curved faintly. He hoped this version would give him something better than the folding bike he could obtain.
Something faster, sturdier, something that could carry him across dangerous terrain would be welcomed.
He exhaled slowly, forcing himself to stay calm. He wanted to immediately open the bundle, but the system message hadn’t stopped yet.
[ Survivor Leaderboard Updated ]
[ Current Rank: #1 ]
[ Congratulations! You are now the first survivor to reach Level 10. ]
[ Reminder: Rankings will be recalculated every 30 days. ]
[ Maintain your position for 30 consecutive days to receive an Exclusive Reward. ]
Kai paused as he saw the message, as if he was being tasked to accept a mission to defend his ranking.
"So it’s here..." he muttered.
Apparently, he felt that the system wasn’t just acknowledging his achievement, it was challenging him.
Thirty days!
He had to hold his position against every survivor across the continent.
’This exclusive reward... you better make it worth it,’Kai mused. There was no room for complacency. He had to continue working hard, pushing himself further, and ensuring no one could surpass him.
Of course, he wasn’t the only one who noticed the Leaderboard update. His companions immediately turned to him.
Claire’s eyes widened as she glanced at her own interface. Ralph gasped, and Victor let out a sharp whistle.
"Kai... you’re on the Leaderboard!" Claire exclaimed, her voice trembling with excitement.
Ralph grinned, shaking his head in disbelief. "The first one... Level 10 already. Damn, that’s insane."
Victor chuckled. He was awed at Kai’s achievement and couldn’t help but tease him a bit.
"Guess we’ve got a celebrity among us now."
Even Terrence and Jonas, who had been quiet, looked at him with a mix of respect and envy. Aurora’s lips also curved into a faint smile, her eyes lingering on him longer than usual.
Needless to say, they were all happy to be with the Rank 1 Survivor. They might not know how Kai had advanced so quickly, but simply being his allies made them feel safer, more confident.
For a moment, they forgot worrying about the families they left behind after they got separated during the Apocalypse Selection.
One by one, the survivors began to congratulate him.
Some clapped him on the shoulder, others nodded in acknowledgment. Their relief from surviving the siege now turned to admiration for the man who had just become Rank 1.
Kai forced a small smile, accepting their words, but inside, he was still concerned about his future.
’Thirty days... I can’t let my guard down. That reward is important. I’ll have to fight harder than ever.’
The congratulations lingered for a while, but soon the survivors’ attention shifted back to reality. Haven‐45, their shelter, was in ruins.
The walls were cracked, the barricades shattered, and the once‐secure tunnels had been torn apart during the siege.
They literally closed their entry points to ensure that the Sentinels, Hounds, and Swarmers wouldn’t find them.
As soon as they were able to carve a path to exit, Victor was the first to voice what everyone was thinking.
"We can’t stay here like this. Even if we patch the ceiling and walls, the foundation’s too damaged."
Ralph sighed as he also surveyed the wreckage. "Yeah... rebuilding is possible, but it’ll take a lot of time and resources. If we don’t do the repair properly, it might collapse on us someday.
Kai then glanced at Russel, Irene, and others who had been living in this shelter for a long time.
As expected, there was some hesitation in their faces since this place... was still their home.
Irene, the nurse who had cared for all the injured, noticed Kai’s gaze and nodded.

"Home is where we can live safely. If it’s true that the A.I. Army’s activity has gone low, maybe this is the time to move. Find somewhere stronger, somewhere we can build without fear of another siege breaking us so easily..." She softly said.
In the end, the final decision was on Kai.
To leave or not to leave...

Enhanced Gift Packs provide superior resources compared to their basic versions, offering better items, higher durability, and expanded utility. ]
Kai’s eyes widened.
He had grown familiar with the basic Gift Packs thanks to his SSS Talent, Infinite Gift Pack.
But this was different.
These weren’t ordinary bundles.
They were enhanced versions!
Just as the description said, they contained far greater resources than anything he had opened before.
His pulse quickened.
’This is perfect timing...
Now, I’ll know what’s next.’He mused.
Well, he couldn’t help but feel excited about this.
After all, this might be the path of his Talent.
Perhaps, in the future, his Infinite Gift Pack could evolve to generate Enhanced Gift Packs instead of the current Basic Gift Pack.
It wasn’t possible yet, but the thought filled him with anticipation.
Right now, even if he hadn’t seen the contents yet, he could already imagine how good they’d be.
An Enhanced Food Pack could probably provide supplies that lasted weeks, maybe even delicacies that couldn’t be found before.
An Enhanced Weapon Pack might contain rare armament.
Well, a higher caliber gun might also be better, considering how he only got a revolver for the current one.
Even the Entertainment Pack mattered.
Kai believed morale was as vital as food in long‐term survival.
He remembered the group of survivors who had betrayed Haven‐45...
They were definitely not hungry, but they had been unhappy, restless, and disconnected.
Perhaps, with better Entertainment Packs, people would feel a sense of belonging and stability in the shelter he wanted to build.
And the Transport Pack...
Kai’s lips curved faintly.
He hoped this version would give him something better than the folding bike he could obtain.
Something faster, sturdier, something that could carry him across dangerous terrain would be welcomed.
He exhaled slowly, forcing himself to stay calm.
He wanted to immediately open the bundle, but the system message hadn’t stopped yet.
[ Survivor Leaderboard Updated ]
[ Current Rank: #1 ]
[ Congratulations!
You are now the first survivor to reach Level 10. ]
[ Reminder: Rankings will be recalculated every 30 days. ]
[ Maintain your position for 30 consecutive days to receive an Exclusive Reward. ]
Kai paused as he saw the message, as if he was being tasked to accept a mission to defend his ranking.
"So it’s here..." he muttered.
Apparently, he felt that the system wasn’t just acknowledging his achievement, it was challenging him.
Thirty days!
He had to hold his position against every survivor across the continent.
’This exclusive reward... you better make it worth it,’Kai mused.
There was no room for complacency.
He had to continue working hard, pushing himself further, and ensuring no one could surpass him.
Of course, he wasn’t the only one who noticed the Leaderboard update.
His companions immediately turned to him.
Claire’s eyes widened as she glanced at her own interface.
Ralph gasped, and Victor let out a sharp whistle.
"Kai... you’re on the Leaderboard!" Claire exclaimed, her voice trembling with excitement.
Ralph grinned, shaking his head in disbelief.
"The first one...
Level 10 already.
Damn, that’s insane."
Victor chuckled.
He was awed at Kai’s achievement and couldn’t help but tease him a bit.
"Guess we’ve got a celebrity among us now."
Even Terrence and Jonas, who had been quiet, looked at him with a mix of respect and envy.
Aurora’s lips also curved into a faint smile, her eyes lingering on him longer than usual.
Needless to say, they were all happy to be with the Rank 1 Survivor.
They might not know how Kai had advanced so quickly, but simply being his allies made them feel safer, more confident.
For a moment, they forgot worrying about the families they left behind after they got separated during the Apocalypse Selection.
One by one, the survivors began to congratulate him.
Some clapped him on the shoulder, others nodded in acknowledgment.
Their relief from surviving the siege now turned to admiration for the man who had just become Rank 1.
Kai forced a small smile, accepting their words, but inside, he was still concerned about his future.
’Thirty days...
I can’t let my guard down.
That reward is important.
I’ll have to fight harder than ever.’
The congratulations lingered for a while, but soon the survivors’ attention shifted back to reality.
Haven‐45, their shelter, was in ruins.
The walls were cracked, the barricades shattered, and the once‐secure tunnels had been torn apart during the siege.
They literally closed their entry points to ensure that the Sentinels, Hounds, and Swarmers wouldn’t find them.
As soon as they were able to carve a path to exit, Victor was the first to voice what everyone was thinking.
"We can’t stay here like this.
Even if we patch the ceiling and walls, the foundation’s too damaged."
Ralph sighed as he also surveyed the wreckage.
"Yeah... rebuilding is possible, but it’ll take a lot of time and resources.
If we don’t do the repair properly, it might collapse on us someday.
Kai then glanced at Russel, Irene, and others who had been living in this shelter for a long time.
As expected, there was some hesitation in their faces since this place... was still their home.
Irene, the nurse who had cared for all the injured, noticed Kai’s gaze and nodded.
"Home is where we can live safely.
If it’s true that the A.I.
Army’s activity has gone low, maybe this is the time to move.
Find somewhere stronger, somewhere we can build without fear of another siege breaking us so easily..." She softly said.
In the end, the final decision was on Kai.
To leave or not to leave...

chapters.title: Chapter 59: The Decision and Talent Reveal
paragraphs: If they stayed here, they would spend precious time repairing walls and patching holes.
Without a doubt, it would take a long time, and they could become vulnerable to another attack... either from the Mechanical Army or from other survivors who needed more resources.
If they moved, however, they would face the unknown, but perhaps gain a better foothold...
Kai exhaled slowly. Everyone was waiting for his decision, but he couldn’t decide immediately, not when several lives were hanging in the balance.
"We have two choices... Rebuild Haven‐45, or search for a new location while the A.I. Army is quiet. What’s your opinion?"
The survivors went silent as they just turned to him, waiting.
Being Rank 1 on the leaderboard wasn’t just a title, it also solidified his position as their leader. Whether he wanted it or not, they would follow him...
Indeed, they just wanted to be with Kai, who had a very unusual way of obtaining resources.
"What should we do? I’m cool with whatever you decide, leader..." Victor replied.
"Me too... I trust your decision, Kai. No one will blame you. But if you’re not here, I’ll probably want to go find another place," Claire voiced out.
Kai sighed.

He was unable to answer immediately but then, he shared his thoughts. "If we rebuild here, we’ll need to reinforce everything, steel beams, timber, stone blocks, all of it. It’ll take time, but we know the terrain. We know how to reinforce or defend it... However, this place isn’t really the best area to build a shelter. Sentinels come here from time to time to dump their waste materials, and those things can be dangerous to us."

Although they could scavenge a lot of things here, they could be discovered by the A.I. Army, and they might even contract some sort of disease from the rotten wastes. After all, even if they had consumed the Gene Serum, it only strengthened their physique and gave them resistance to various diseases, but it didn’t grant immunity to sickness.
Everyone nodded after hearing this. They knew about the downside of staying here. Thankfully, there was also merit in moving...

"If we move, we’ll need to scout the area carefully, but it has to be quick... The Army may be quiet now, but that won’t last forever," Kai said as he looked around at the cracked walls and unstable ceiling.

"This might be our only chance to move away. The Mechanical Army spent most of its resources and soldiers during the Global Event, but they’ll recover. Once this break is over, they’ll probably sweep this area again."
"I can agree to that..." Victor added. "This place is also getting too small because we collapsed some of our tunnels to fight back."
The Survivors who had been silently listening also nodded.

Kai smiled seeing this. "Yes... Haven‐45 is too small. Even if we rebuild, it won’t hold more than a few dozen people comfortably. We need space, room for storage, defenses, and growth. If we stay here, we’ll always be cramped... and always vulnerable."

The survivors listened intently as Ralph finally spoke to share his thoughts. "And don’t forget the waste. The Sentinels dump their broken parts and other waste here. That’s why they keep coming back. This place is a graveyard for machines, and graveyards attract other scavengers. The longer we stay, the more likely we’ll be discovered again..."
Kai turned to Ralph and nodded. He had certainly been thinking the same. Although there were some benefits to staying here, they could face far more problems.
In any case, with his talent, they wouldn’t have to worry about resources. They just needed to work for him, and they’d get Gift Packs in exchange.
Terrence, who had no idea about Kai’s ability, felt a little worried. Still, he already considered himself part of this group and spoke.

"We need better conditions. A shelter with clean water nearby, natural barriers we can use, and enough space to build defenses that won’t collapse under pressure. Somewhere we can expand, not just survive day to day."
"Yes... That’s why we have to move now... Does any of you have a different opinion? If you want to stay here, I won’t stop you." Kai announced.
No one spoke up to object. The silence itself was an answer, every survivor understood that Haven‐45 was no longer a home they could rely on.
Kai nodded once.
"Then it’s settled. We’ll move. First, we need to scout the area above us. We can’t march blindly into the unknown."

He scanned the group, weighing their strengths. "Russel, you’re our best scout. Wallace, I heard you just mentioned that your Swift Stride just reached Level 3, we’ll need your speed if things go wrong. And I’ll go myself. The rest of you will stay here and prepare supplies."
"I’ll join you! I will be helpful!" Terrence added as he was confident with his Pathfinder Talent.
Kai thought for a moment before he nodded.
"Very well."
Just like that, Kai used his Talent and opened three more Stealth Gift Packs.
Their contents were a camouflage suit, night vision goggles, a suppressor, and a smoke grenade...
The suppressor or silencer wasn’t really fit to the revolver, so they were just being collected and stored somewhere.
The unaware survivors gasped as some of them had no idea about Kai’s ability.
However, seeing that the others were calm and not questioning anything, they just kept their silence.
Indeed, at this point, no one questioned Kai’s skills anymore.
Even if his ability should have been limited, as he mentioned before, none of them cared. He had secrets, yes, but those secrets kept them alive.
Still, for Samantha, Terrence, and the others, the shock was real, they finally had an idea about Kai’s mysterious talent!
No wonder he’s the leader.
Still, none of them voiced their comment. Respect and trust had already taken root.
Kai adjusted his own camouflage suit, then exhaled.
"Prepare yourselves. We leave at dawn."
Later, as the camp settled to rest, Kai returned to his tent.
At last, he focused on his Enhanced Gift Pack Bundle!

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Recollection
paragraphs: Kai didn’t doubt that this Enhanced Gift Pack would be better.
Right now, he was only praying that he’d get something really cool!

He wanted the Food Gift Pack to have better selections and include some spices, the Weapon Gift Pack to give him a machine gun or a rifle, the Stealth Gift Pack to give him an invisibility cloak, the Energy Gift Pack to give him Spirit Energy potions, the Transport Gift Pack to give him an ATV, or maybe even his Shelter Gift Pack to give him a bunker or something...
Pfft!
Kai couldn’t help but laugh at himself as he reached this thought.
Some of his wishes were just too unrealistic.

However, the only reason why he really wanted them to be special was because of his belief that his SSS Talent would soon adapt and change his Basic Gift Packs to Enhanced Gift Packs in the near future.
"Alright... Let’s open this bundle!"
[ Do you wish to open the bundle? ]
[ Note: All Gift Packs will be transferred to your Inventory. ]
"Yes!"
Kai replied, and in an instant, the bundle disappeared, forming 10 Enhanced Gift Packs in his Inventory.
After taking a deep breath, Kai checked the notifications...
[ Energy Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: high-capacity power bank, foldable solar charger, LED lantern, and rechargeable battery pack. ]
Kai paused as he saw the content... They actually removed the radio and changed it to an LED lantern. Then, the normal batteries became rechargeable.
Still, Kai didn’t open it yet and checked the rest of the notifications.
[ Entertainment Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: durable board game set, illustrated books and guides, portable music player set, and sketch pad with pencils. ]
[ Food Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: vacuum‐sealed rations, canned goods, dried fruits and nuts, instant soup packs, coffee sachets, and portable cooking stove with fuel canisters. ]
Once again, the contents didn’t mention any specific details... Like what board game it was, what kind of books were there, what canned goods or rations would be given, and others.
Still, Kai didn’t complain and continued checking the rest.
[ Medical Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: expanded first aid kit, antiseptic wipes, disinfectant spray, wound‐closure strips, splints, surgical scissors, fever reducer tablets. ]
[ Shelter Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: field tent, insulated sleeping bag, heavy-duty flashlight, thermal blanket, heavy-duty raincoat. ]
[ Stealth Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: ghillie suit, enhanced night vision goggles, smoke grenade, stun grenade, and signal jammer ]
Kai paused for a moment as he processed the new information.
He couldn’t help but frown at the Medical Gift Pack.

"Hmm... so the painkillers and antibiotics are gone... or maybe they’re inside the kit? Still, they gave me antiseptic wipes, disinfectant spray, and even surgical scissors. Splints and wound‐closure strips, too... That’s definitely more advanced... Interesting."
As for the Shelter Gift Pack, he couldn’t help but scratch his head. From a camping tent to a field tent that could probably fit multiple people was a great change.
Then came the Stealth Gift Pack. It had improved a lot.

"The camouflage suit turned into a ghillie suit. Instead of a silencer, they gave me smoke and stun grenades... plus a signal jammer? This is incredible... I hope it works against Swarmers to stop them from sending signals." Kai mused.
"Whatever... These Enhanced packs really are upgrades..."
Kai muttered as he checked the rest of them.
[ Survival Tools Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: fire starter kit, wristwatch, compass, sturdy multi-tool knife, long rope, portable radio transciever set. ]
[ Transport Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: mountain bicycle, protective riding gear, repair kit with spare parts, collapsible canoe. ]
"A wristwatch? That’s awesome, and wait... a collapsible canoe?" Kai muttered in disbelief.
They were definitely important items!
Now, he was hopeful that his Weapon Gift Pack would provide something better.
[ Water Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: advanced water filter, filled bottles, purification tablets, collapsible bucket, water gallons, hydration pack, and insulated canteen. ]
[ Weapon Gift Pack (Enhanced)
Contents: semi‐automatic pistol with spare magazines, reinforced hatchet, combat knife, extra ammunition, tactical holster. ]
Kai’s eyes widened as he reached the Water Gift Pack.
"Hydration pack, and an insulated canteen... Wow. That’s a huge change." He muttered.
Then he checked the Weapon Gift Pack and smiled.

"From a revolver to a semi‐automatic pistol with spare magazines... That’s a serious upgrade. Faster reloads, more shots, and paired with a combat knife and hatchet? Plus extra ammo and a tactical holster. This pack actually feels like it’s built for real combat now."
Kai nodded to himself, satisfied.
"The Gift Packs are not just practical items anymore... They were more specialized. It’s like the system knows exactly what I’ll need out there."
Just like that, since they would be scouting for a new shelter soon, Kai decided to open the Weapon Gift Pack and the Stealth Gift Pack first.
"Awesome... A ghillie suit might be too much for me, but the others would appreciate this for sure." He muttered.
Then, while Kai was still busy sorting through the notifications, he heard faint voices outside his tent.
Well, the lights were still on, so it wasn’t surprising someone noticed.
But visitors at this hour? That caught him off guard.
He stepped out and saw two figures waiting. They were survivors, patients who had been rescued before Althea and Sera.
Kai recognized them immediately.
They had once been chained as living shields to the Sentinels...
Most of their group had perished, but these two had somehow survived through sheer luck and will to live.
Now, they stood in simple clothes with garments clearly meant for sleeping. The fabric clung lightly to their physique, almost enticing, but Kai forced himself to stay focused.
He cleared his throat and asked, "Why are you here?"
The two exchanged uneasy glances before speaking.
Soon, they explained that they had remembered something about their previous site, a place where humans were being kept like livestock.
"What of it?" Kai asked.
"I think with your current weapons and numbers... you can take it over," Sera said firmly. And of course, Kai now had to listen.
"Really? Tell me more about it..."
He hadn’t expected them to approach him now, let alone bring such information.
Still, whatever they remembered could change everything about their next move.
After listening to them for some time, Kai clenched his fist tightly.
It seemed they were no longer preparing to scout for shelter, they might be preparing to conquer an A.I. base instead!
