chapters.title: Chapter 61: Attacking the A.I. Army’s Base
paragraphs: Kai listened carefully as Sera and Althea shared what they knew about the A.I. Army’s base. He could feel their anger in every word as they explained the situation there...
They had been humiliated, chained as shields, treated as nothing more than expendable bodies. Now, they wanted revenge. Kai understood them perfectly.
"So it was like that..." Kai muttered as he listened.

The base they described wasn’t the terrifying fortress Kai had imagined. It wasn’t a factory producing endless waves of mechanical soldiers, nor was it a fortified city filled with defenses. Instead, it was an old mining site, a place once used by captives to dig for silver.
But the silver was long gone, the tunnels had collapsed, and the mine itself had been abandoned. The Sentinels had simply repurposed the area, turning it into a holding ground.

"That’s right. There’s no underground network to hide in, no production lines churning out new machines. What remains is a warehouse-like compound where captives are kept..." Sera explained, her voice tight with bitterness.

Kai also learned that the Sentinels stationed there were older models, numbering no more than two hundred. That was still a daunting force, especially for Kai’s small group armed with only a couple of repaired high-tech rifles and their newly acquired Gift Packs. But it was possible to defeat them!
The key detail was that these old D-Grade Sentinels needed power. They weren’t self-sustaining or equipped with Energy Cores like the newer C-Grade models.

They relied on a single generator and a fragile electrical grid to keep themselves charged and coordinated. Without it, they would get in troube. Their batteries would drain, their sensors would weaken, and their ability to communicate would collapse.

Kai’s mind sharpened as he realized the opportunity. They didn’t need to fight two hundred Sentinels head-on. They needed to strike the generator... and perhaps wait until their systems were compromised.
Sera’s voice was fierce. "This might be our only chance."
Althea added as she saw Kai’s hesitation.
"The warehouse is locked by electronic gates. Without power, those gates will fail. The captives can be freed. And the Sentinels... they’ll be nothing but chunks of metal waiting to shut down."
Kai nodded slowly and sighed.
He must admit that this plan seemed possible. In fact, he was curious to see if it would work against the enemy. In the long run, he needed a strategy to deal with the mechanical soldiers...
Still, he also knew he had to be careful. Escape routes and backup plans were essential in case they failed.

He then closed his eyes and began to imagine the operation. At dawn, they could move silently, using stealth gear to approach the compound. The signal jammer might sever Sentinel coordination, though Kai wasn’t sure if its effect would be strong enough. Still, with smoke grenades, they could create confusion or diversion. Then, while the machines scrambled, they would strike the generator.

Once the grid collapsed, the Sentinels wouldn’t weaken immediately, but their power would drain over time. They weren’t using solar energy anyway. Perhaps the higher-grade models could, but not these ones.
"But this is not going to be easy..." Kai muttered, conflicted.
He knew battles weren’t always won by brute strength. Sometimes, they were won by strategy, by exploiting a flaw. And this enemy base had a flaw... its dependence on power.
Kai then turned to the two...
"We’ll hit the generator... Do you have any idea about their operating time?"
Sera and Althea exchanged a look before replying. "When we were imprisoned, there were changes of guards every twelve hours."

Kai nodded. Of course, that didn’t mean they could only operate for twelve hours. Perhaps it was twenty-four or more, but the Sentinels were simply programmed to recharge once their batteries dropped to fifty percent or so. That detail mattered. It meant they had predictable cycles, moments when their strength dipped.
"Fine... Let’s do this!" Kai declared...

He knew the risks. Two hundred Sentinels were still a terrifying prospect. But he also knew the reward. If they succeeded, it wouldn’t just be revenge. It would be proof that humans could fight back. It would mean they could take control of the base, free the captives, and strike a blow against the machines.
Kai clenched his fist tightly as he soon gathered his team...
Two days later, Kai was able to bring his small team to the outskirts of the enemy base.
The journey wasn’t long, but during the past two days, Kai had worked tirelessly, sketching out strategies, weighing risks, and refining ideas.
With everyone’s input, they had managed to create three distinct plans... each one designed to exploit the Sentinels’ dependence on electricity.
The team was small but determined to win this...
There was Kai himself, Ralph, Wallace, Claire, Terrence, and, of course, Althea and Sera.
While they didn’t know the inside layout of the base, they were familiar with the surrounding terrain. That knowledge was invaluable.
"So that’s the place, huh," Wallace muttered as he looked at the structure ahead.
"It’s not as terrifying as I thought." Kai muttered.
"Not bad for our new base, huh." Terrence commented as he looked at the base.
It wasn’t a fortress of steel and towers. There weren’t even automated turrets or other defensive structures.
It was as if they were confident that no one would attack them at all!

"This is good for us," Kai muttered. He noticed that the industrial buildings of the base seemed ordinary, just the same structures left behind when the mine was abandoned. There had been no improvements made at all.
"Where is it?" Kai whispered as his eyes scanned the compound. Well, the largest structure was the warehouse, a rectangular block of concrete and rusting steel, so he ignored it for now.

Still, it didn’t take long before Kai spotted what he was looking for. Faint lines of power cables snaked across the ground, converging toward a squat generator building at the far end of the compound.
"Found you. So that’s the generator building..." Kai muttered as he looked at Ralph, who was holding the plasma rifle.
It was time to commence their Operation Blackout!

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Operation Blackout ( Part 1 )
paragraphs: The team crouched among the rocks overlooking the compound or the base of the A.I. Army.
From their position, they could already hear the faint movement of machinery, but they all focused on the generator at the eastern side of the compound.
Kai took a deep breath as he turned to Ralph. "That’s our target. Once it’s gone, the Sentinels won’t last long without power."
Ralph adjusted the plasma rifle in his hands...
Currently, this was the only weapon they had that could seriously damage a Sentinel and the power generator.
"Three shots each. That’s all we’ve got. We’ll have to make them count." Ralph muttered.
Since he had Sharpshooter’s Focus Talent, there was no one else who could handle this task.
Kai nodded. "Exactly."

They were not here to fight two hundred Sentinels. They’re here to cripple them. Once the generator was destroyed, they simply had to vanish, hide, and wait. Their batteries will drain, and then they’ll be nothing but scrap.
The problem was the fact that the Sentinels, Swarmers, and Hounds wouldn’t do anything about it.
They would surely try to track them. Those mechanical wolves were the most dangerous part of this mission.
Their detectors seemed as if they could pick up energy signatures and even faint traces of movement.
That was why they’ve also prepared escape routes. They would have to use smoke grenades, fire traps, and others for diversions...
If it comes to it, they might even have to abandon the plasma rifles, since their energy emissions could give away their location.
Claire also recalled their plan as she checked the pack of grenades strapped to her belt.
"We’ll have to move fast. Once the shots are fired, the Sentinels will swarm us." She muttered.
This time, Althea and Sera, who were only here to set up the fire traps on their escape route and guide them, nodded.
They were also equipped with revolvers and a couple of smoke grenades for cover, but they would be the first ones to move away and escape.
"Remember," Kai said firmly... "our mission is sabotage, no detours or rescuing those captured. We cut their power and get out. That’s all." He reminded them once again.
They were humans after all. They were prone to mistakes. Kai was worried that if they saw the ’meatshield’ used by the A.I., they would hesitate.
That should not happen, or they’ll get into trouble.
"Roger that..."
The team nodded as they readied themselves.
Kai liked their expression, so he turned his gaze back to the generator building at the far end of the compound, to the traps they laid out to ensure they wouldn’t get followed before he whispered...
"Operation Blackout begins now..."
Kai had spent two days refining their approach...
The first plan was ’Direct Strike.’

Ralph and Wallace would use the plasma rifles to target the generator directly. The rest of the team would deploy smoke grenades and fire traps to create chaos, drawing patrols away from the strike zone. Once the generator was destroyed, everyone would retreat along the northern escape path, disappearing into the rocky terrain.
The second plan was the ’Diversion Sabotage.’

If the Hounds detected them too early, before they could get in range to hit the generator, Claire and Terrence would ignite the fire traps first, creating a wall of smoke and flame to mask their movements.
After all, the Plasma Rifle had a limited range, and that was the reason why they even won against the Sentinels during the Mech Siege.
Still, Kai had to open lots of Survivor Gift Packs to get more fire starter kits for this second plan.
Once the diversion was made, Ralph and Wallace would fire all the plasma shots if needed to cripple the generator, then retreat immediately.
As for the third plan, it was the ’Emergency Retreat...’

If both rifles failed or the generator proved too resilient, they would abandon the strike entirely. The team would scatter along pre-planned escape routes, leaving behind decoys and burning equipment to confuse the Sentinels. The mission would be considered a failure, but survival would take priority.
’I hope this is enough preparation...’ Kai thought to himself.
Well, it wouldn’t be surprising if he missed something. However, he was hoping that it wouldn’t be too much, and they could still escape with all the plans he prepared.
Soon, the group moved into position as they slipped across the barren ground.
Smoke grenades were readied, escape paths memorized, and the plasma rifles primed for their single, devastating purpose.
Thankfully, this base was old, and the Mechanical Army was not using any surveillance network unless they released their Swarmers. This place was a perfect target for Kai’s team!
Whom~
The hum of the generator grew louder as they crept closer.
Every step brought them nearer to the heart of the enemy...
Kai’s pulse quickened.’There’s no turning back now...’
He could see the patrols. They looked stiff with methodical movements of the D-Grade Sentinels.
Well, it also wouldn’t be surprising if they were even E-Grade Sentinels, seeing how dirty and rusty those limbs were.
Kai then raised his hand, signaling silence.
Thud...
The team froze and crouched low behind the rusting remains of an old mining cart.

At this distance, the cables leading to the generator were already close. It was carrying the current that sustained the machines, but cutting that off was useless... Their only target was the generator.
They soon moved closer, and this time, they were even quieter...
"This is it," Kai whispered. "Ralph, Wallace... you’ll fire when I give the signal. Claire, Terrence, grenades ready. Althea, Sera... cover our retreat."
They already knew, but Kai had to repeat their plans.
The team nodded.
Seeing that they’re ready, Kai finally smiled.
"Let’s cut their lifeline."
With the signal, Ralph and Wallace raised their rifles, aiming at the generator building.
Because of the nature of the rifles, it hummed as it gathered energy...
Indeed, its energy cores or batteries were straining against their limits. Thankfully, this was not a long process. Even if they were detected, it would be too late for the complacent Sentinels!
Wallace squeezed the trigger first...
A blinding bolt of plasma shot across the compound, striking the generator’s outer wall!
Boom!
The impact exploded and tore through steel and concrete!
Ralph fired immediately after.
This time, his shot pierced deeper into the structure!

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Operation Blackout ( Part 2 )
paragraphs: Boom!
The generator shook violently as the plasma blast hit. The walls crumbled, the steel cracked, and sparks flew in every direction.
Needless to say, cables snapped one after another, spraying arcs of electricity across the ground.
The previous sound of the generator was drowned out by explosions, replaced by the roar of fire and the screech of tearing metal.
Alarms blared instantly. Red lights flashed across the compound. Sentinels turned their heads in unison, optics glowing brighter as they detected the attack.
Soon, the Hounds moved with their detectors, locking onto the plasma emissions.
Now, it was a race against time.
"Grenades!" Kai shouted.
Claire and Terrence pulled the pins and threw smoke grenades. Thick clouds spread quickly, covering the team’s position.
Althea and Sera then lit the fire traps they had prepared. Soon, the oil‐soaked debris burst into flames, sending black smoke into the air!
Just like that, more torches and grenades were thrown into chaos as alarms screamed, fire spread, and smoke choked the area.
Of course, the Sentinels reacted immediately.
Some rushed toward the generator building, trying to save whatever they could, probably to repair it.
Others traced the source of the disturbance.
However, the Hounds were different. They charged through the smoke with their detectors sweeping for energy signals.
One Hound locked onto Wallace’s plasma rifle.
Its sensors noticed it, and it sprinted straight toward him!
They even heard its claws scraping the ground! So they knew that the Hound was close.
"Drop it!" Kai yelled.
Wallace amd Ralph didn’t hesitate. They threw the rifle into the burning debris. The weapon hissed as its energy signature was swallowed by the flames.
The Hound stopped, probably processing what had happened, then turned its sensors elsewhere.
"Move!" Kai ordered.
The team ran, moving through smoke and fire.
More smoke grenades exploded behind them.
Furthermore, with the sudden disruption of electricity, many devices in the compound stopped functioning, adding to the chaos.
Even if the Sentinels tried to follow, their optics were blinded by the smoke.
These low‐grade models didn’t have advanced sensors.
They were likely relying on image scanners, which could be blocked easily by smoke or cover.
Still, Kai’s lungs burned as he sprinted through the haze... It was not easy moving through the smoke as well!
Then, at this time, the Sentinels began firing wildly with their own plasma rifles!
It was as if they had received instructions not to care about the base anymore, only to fire at will.
Bam! Bam!
Heat from the flames pressed against Kai’s skin.
Nonetheless, they had succeeded, and they were able to move away!
Kai looked back and confirmed that the generator was collapsing. Its walls crumbled, and explosions had definitely ripped through its core, as fire consumed everything.
They had done it.
But survival was not certain.
The Hounds followed them through the chaos with detectors still sweeping desperately.
Kai signaled to Althea and Sera.
They threw more torches and smoke grenades, masking the team’s retreat.
However, it was not going to be easy.
Before they could reach the rocky terrain, Kai suddenly froze. His Level 3 Keen Senses allowed him to detect every sound and movement around him.
He heard the faint scrape of metal feet through the smoke! He noticed their movement, including the rhythm of weapons being raised!
"Enemies incoming!" Kai shouted.
He turned with his revolver already in hand. His eyes tracked the movement of the Sentinels through the haze.
They weren’t visible to anyone else yet, but his Gene Skill let him sense their approach.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
He fired rapidly, one shot after another, emptying the revolver in seconds. Sparks flew as bullets struck their armor and rifles, forcing the Sentinels in front to halt and adjust their positions.
Kai didn’t reload. He dropped the revolver and pulled out his semi‐automatic pistol. Without hesitation, he fired again, sweeping the weapon across the smoke‐covered shapes.
Each shot wasn’t meant to kill, it was meant to slow them down, to break their rhythm.
"Shoot in their direction!" Kai ordered.
Claire, Terrence, Althea, and Sera raised their revolvers and opened fire.
Bang! Bang!
A series of gunfire echoed through the compound as bullets cut through the smoke...
Of course, this action revealed their position. However, Kai had other plans.
"Continue firing!" Kai ordered.
The Hounds tried to lock onto the team, but the constant barrage disrupted them. Their sensors were vulnerable and could be hit easily!
Still, it was only a matter of time before they moved again.
Kai’s senses picked up more movement. More Sentinels were closing in. He could feel the ground tremble under their steps.
"They’re coming in numbers!" Kai shouted.
He reached into his pack and pulled out the Signal Jammer he had obtained from the Enhanced Stealth Gift Pack.
The device was small and box‐shaped. Without hesitation, Kai slammed his thumb on the switch.
Whom~
A wave of disrupting frequency spread through the air.
The Sentinels’ optics seemed to flash as their detectors failed!
The Hounds also froze for a moment as their sensors received errors!
"It worked!" Kai’s eyes lit up as the jammer disrupted their signals. For a brief moment, the machines lost coordination.
"Now! Move!" Kai yelled.
The team didn’t waste a second. They sprinted toward the escape path with smoke grenades protecting them from sight.
The fire traps roared higher, masking their retreat.
Soon, Kai’s Keen Senses told him the enemy was regrouping, but the disturbance gave them the gap they needed!
The group broke through the edge of the compound and dashed into the rocky terrain.
Just in time, the Signal Jammer finally stopped working!
However, they already escaped!
After ten minutes of running, the group soon entered a sewer that they had previously marked.
"We can finally rest..." Wallace muttered as he felt breathless.

"Damn... The plasma rifles should be fixed or upgraded. The short range is just too dangerous," Ralph muttered, knowing how risky the mission had been. If the Plasma Rifle had a longer range, they wouldn’t have to gamble their lives like this.
Unfortunately, Victor was only a mechanic, not an engineer specializing in advanced tech. There was a limit to how much he could repair on such devices.
"You can complain to him later, once we survive this," Kai muttered as they finally slowed when they reached cover.
But before they could rest, Claire shouted, "Get down!"

Wallace amd Ralph didn’t hesitate.
They threw the rifle into the burning debris.
The weapon hissed as its energy signature was swallowed by the flames.
The Hound stopped, probably processing what had happened, then turned its sensors elsewhere.
"Move!" Kai ordered.
The team ran, moving through smoke and fire.
More smoke grenades exploded behind them.
Furthermore, with the sudden disruption of electricity, many devices in the compound stopped functioning, adding to the chaos.
Even if the Sentinels tried to follow, their optics were blinded by the smoke.
These low‐grade models didn’t have advanced sensors.
They were likely relying on image scanners, which could be blocked easily by smoke or cover.
Still, Kai’s lungs burned as he sprinted through the haze...
It was not easy moving through the smoke as well!
Then, at this time, the Sentinels began firing wildly with their own plasma rifles!
It was as if they had received instructions not to care about the base anymore, only to fire at will.
Bam!
Bam!
Heat from the flames pressed against Kai’s skin.
Nonetheless, they had succeeded, and they were able to move away!
Kai looked back and confirmed that the generator was collapsing.
Its walls crumbled, and explosions had definitely ripped through its core, as fire consumed everything.
They had done it.
But survival was not certain.
The Hounds followed them through the chaos with detectors still sweeping desperately.
Kai signaled to Althea and Sera.
They threw more torches and smoke grenades, masking the team’s retreat.
However, it was not going to be easy.
Before they could reach the rocky terrain, Kai suddenly froze.
His Level 3 Keen Senses allowed him to detect every sound and movement around him.
He heard the faint scrape of metal feet through the smoke!
He noticed their movement, including the rhythm of weapons being raised!
"Enemies incoming!" Kai shouted.
He turned with his revolver already in hand.
His eyes tracked the movement of the Sentinels through the haze.
They weren’t visible to anyone else yet, but his Gene Skill let him sense their approach.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
He fired rapidly, one shot after another, emptying the revolver in seconds.
Sparks flew as bullets struck their armor and rifles, forcing the Sentinels in front to halt and adjust their positions.
Kai didn’t reload.
He dropped the revolver and pulled out his semi‐automatic pistol.
Without hesitation, he fired again, sweeping the weapon across the smoke‐covered shapes.
Each shot wasn’t meant to kill, it was meant to slow them down, to break their rhythm.
"Shoot in their direction!" Kai ordered.
Claire, Terrence, Althea, and Sera raised their revolvers and opened fire.
Bang!
Bang!
A series of gunfire echoed through the compound as bullets cut through the smoke...
Of course, this action revealed their position.
However, Kai had other plans.
"Continue firing!" Kai ordered.
The Hounds tried to lock onto the team, but the constant barrage disrupted them.
Their sensors were vulnerable and could be hit easily!
Still, it was only a matter of time before they moved again.
Kai’s senses picked up more movement.
More Sentinels were closing in.
He could feel the ground tremble under their steps.
"They’re coming in numbers!" Kai shouted.
He reached into his pack and pulled out the Signal Jammer he had obtained from the Enhanced Stealth Gift Pack.
The device was small and box‐shaped.
Without hesitation, Kai slammed his thumb on the switch.
Whom~
A wave of disrupting frequency spread through the air.
The Sentinels’ optics seemed to flash as their detectors failed!
The Hounds also froze for a moment as their sensors received errors!
"It worked!" Kai’s eyes lit up as the jammer disrupted their signals.
For a brief moment, the machines lost coordination.
"Now!
Move!" Kai yelled.
The team didn’t waste a second.
They sprinted toward the escape path with smoke grenades protecting them from sight.
The fire traps roared higher, masking their retreat.
Soon, Kai’s Keen Senses told him the enemy was regrouping, but the disturbance gave them the gap they needed!
The group broke through the edge of the compound and dashed into the rocky terrain.
Just in time, the Signal Jammer finally stopped working!
However, they already escaped!
After ten minutes of running, the group soon entered a sewer that they had previously marked.
"We can finally rest..." Wallace muttered as he felt breathless.
"Damn...
The plasma rifles should be fixed or upgraded.
The short range is just too dangerous," Ralph muttered, knowing how risky the mission had been.
If the Plasma Rifle had a longer range, they wouldn’t have to gamble their lives like this.
Unfortunately, Victor was only a mechanic, not an engineer specializing in advanced tech.
There was a limit to how much he could repair on such devices.
"You can complain to him later, once we survive this," Kai muttered as they finally slowed when they reached cover.
But before they could rest, Claire shouted, "Get down!"

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Operation Blackout ( Part 3 )
paragraphs: Claire’s warning came just in time.
"Get down!" she shouted.
The team dropped instantly, and a plasma bolt tore through the air above them, smashing into the sewer wall.
Boom!
The explosion shook the tunnel, and it sprayed dust and debris.
From the smoke ahead, shadows moved.
There were seven Sentinels waiting in the sewers!
"They’re not here before..."
"How did they even get here?!"
"Shit... Our plasma rifles are gone..."
Everyone was terrified as the Sentinels’ glowing optics focused on their group with their rifles raised...
Immediately, Kai threw a smoke grenade... It should buy them time to get deeper into the sewer, but the enemies still fired!
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Thankfully, no one was hit as they all jumped to the side!
Then, behind the Sentinel, the Hounds started rushing!
"Shit..."
Kai frowned as he realized the situation. "They’ve really tracked us."
Without any instruction from Kai, the group fired their revolvers!
Bang! Bang!
However, despite the volley of attacks, the Sentinels kept advancing with their armor barely scratched.
One Hound pounced forward, faster than the rest, and slammed Terrence to the ground. Its claws dug into the floor, and it was inches from his chest!
"Terrence!" Claire screamed.
She fired her revolver, but the bullets bounced off the Hound’s reinforced armor...
The beast ignored Claire since its detectors locked onto Terrence’s body heat.
It was at this point that Claire heard the spirit’s voice whispering inside her mind...
"Call me. Let me in. Or he dies."
Claire’s heart pounded. She had sworn never to use it this early... Her Health Points had barely improved after all.
She knew that the cost of using the Spirit’s Possession was her Health Point permanently being reduced!
However, Terrence’s terrified eyes met hers, and her hesitation vanished.
"Fine!" she shouted. "Do it!"
Kai heard Claire’s words and thought nothing of it first... However, he soon felt the changes around her using his Keen Sense!
Kai even momentarily paused shooting as he noticed what was happening...
With his skill, he knew every change happening around Claire!
After a few moments, dark energy surged through her body.
Kai had no idea that a mysterious spirit had already poured into her veins, filling her body or muscles with unnatural strength.
Suddenly, her eyes glowed faintly, and her aura changed! Her previously calm demeanor changed as she emitted a heavy, oppressive, and seemingly inhuman aura!
Kai wanted to question her but she suddenly charged forward and she moved faster than anyone could follow!
In just a moment, Claire grabbed the Hound by its neck and ripped it off Terrence with one hand.
Clank!
Metal screeched as her grip crushed its frame.
With a roar, she slammed it into the wall, shattering its sensors.
Bam!
Just like that, sparks burst as the machine collapsed into pieces!
The others froze, stunned by the sudden turn of events!
"Claire...?" Kai muttered, disbelief in his voice.
"What happened to her?"
"Is that really her Physical Strengthening Talent?"
"Maybe she’s using a lot of Spirit Points right now!"
"We should assist her!"
"This doesn’t look like an Uncommon Talent. This is definitely a Superior or even a higher-ranked talent!"
They were all curious but she didn’t stop. Another Sentinel charged forward, rifle raised...
However, Claire positioned herself near a Hound and they actually stopped shooting as expected.
Then, when the others still tried aiming at her, she met them head-on!
She dashed forward and struck her fist into the nearest Sentinel’s chest!
Thud!
The steel armor caved in like paper, and the machine was thrown back into the sewer wall.
Bam!
At this point, Kai and everyone else didn’t know how to react. It was as if Claire was possessed by a mighty warrior!
She even threw her hatchets, jamming the hands of the Sentinels and stopping them from using their rifles!
Everything happened so quickly!
"Support her!" Kai suddenly said as they decided to fight in close combat.
They also drew their hatchets, ready to break the machine apart!
However, Claire was not slowing down!
Her movements were brutal and unstoppable. Every strike shattered metal, and her every kick sent machines flying! It was a terrifying sight.
But during all this time, they had no idea that the spirit’s possession made her a monster among humans.
Yet her life force was burning away. It didn’t even take that long before her chest tightened as she felt her health slipping permanently.
She knew the cost, but she couldn’t stop now!
"Cover me!" Claire shouted as she retreated for a moment to rest.
Kai didn’t hesitate as he switched his blade to a gun once again...
In just a few moments, his team opened fire, forcing the machines to be on the defensive.
Even Claire managed to tear through another Hound while supposedly resting. She really tore its sensors apart with her bare hands.
But more Sentinels were coming!
Furthermore, they should’ve attracted the attention of the enemies outside. They must hurry and leave the place quickly!
Kai frowned at the situation... "We can’t hold them!"
However, Claire’s mysterious spirit whispered,"Push further. I can break them all."
Having no other choice, Claire could only agree! They needed to stop them here!
"Then let’s go!" she growled under her breath.
She smashed another Sentinel aside, then turned to Kai. "Go! I’ll clear the path!"
Kai hesitated, but her aura left no room for argument.
He nodded. "Everyone, move!"
The team sprinted deeper into the sewer while Claire stayed behind...
She simply relied on her fists pounding against steel that could force the machines back!
’Ugh... I’m getting tired.’ Claire thought as every strike drained her, but she didn’t care at this point!
Finally, she broke through the last wave, crushing a Sentinel’s head in her grip and hurling it into the flames!
Claire then stumbled... Her strength was already fading as the spirit withdrew.
’Hey... You have to exercise more! I can’t even last for the whole duration!’The mysterious spirit complained.
But Claire couldn’t entertain the spirit anymore... She just ignored the spirit since her body felt weaker... and after a few seconds, she passed out!
’Shit...’This was the only thing on her mind.
Thankfully, as soon as she woke up, she noticed that she was saved and everyone was staring at her.
Before she could thank them, Ralph whispered.
"Claire... That wasn’t Physical Strengthening. What the hell was that?"

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Operation Blackout ( Part 4 )
paragraphs: Claire immediately sat against the damp wall of the sewer as she tried to catch her breath.
’I’m alive...’she thought.
She also noticed that they were already safe, and only the remains of Sentinels surrounded them.
Their mechanical bodies lay scattered across the tunnel floor. It seemed the group had already looted them as well, stripping their weapons and parts before gathering around her.
"Claire... That wasn’t Physical Strengthening. What the hell was that?" Ralph muttered.
Before she could answer, Wallace jumped in, unable to contain his excitement.
"That was so cool! You’re like a gladiator! I think that cost you something, right? How many Spirit Points do you need to use that? Can you use it again?"
The others surrounded her with their faces filled with curiosity. Yet their expressions weren’t marked by anger or betrayal for keeping her real ability a secret.
After all, they had seen her save Terrence, and that was enough for them.
No one really cared that she had hidden her Talent. As a matter of fact, it also suited her explanation that her Talent was related to Physical Strength.
They just hadn’t imagined it could reach such terrifying levels.
Anyway, they couldn’t help but feel curious about what else she was hiding.
Claire lowered her head as she felt guilty. "I... I lied. My Talent isn’t what I told you before."
Terrence, who had only heard from Wallace that her Talent was Physical Strengthening, curiously asked. "Then what is it? Ahem... If we can ask you."
Seeing her hesitation, Kai also stepped closer and patted her shoulder.
"Don’t force yourself. You don’t owe us an explanation right now."
Of course, Kai said this to guilt‐trip her a little, pushing her toward revealing the truth instead. Thankfully, it worked.
Claire shook her head firmly. "No. I need to say it. You all deserve to know. It’s called Fifth Sin. Epic rank."
The group exchanged glances, stunned by the name and rank of the Talent.
Kai’s eyes lit up. It was better than he had expected.
’Perfect...’
"Epic? That’s... way beyond what you said before."

Claire nodded slowly. "I just didn’t want to make it seem like I wanted to hoard food or money. My Talent helps me grow stronger as I accumulate wealth like food, weapons, and resources. But there’s more. I can let the spirit of the Fifth Seen possess me. That’s what you saw just now. It gives me super strength, but every time I use it, I lose permanent health points..."
Silence followed as they processed the information.
Terrence couldn’t help but frown at the price she had to pay. "You mean... you’re burning away your own life just to fight like that?"
Claire sighed and nodded. "Yes. And I didn’t want anyone to know. I thought... if I kept it hidden, I wouldn’t be tempted to use it. But tonight, I had no choice."
Kai studied her carefully. His Keen Senses picked up the strain in her voice and the fatigue in her body.
He finally spoke. "Then you’ll get priority for the next Gene Serums we find. That’s my promise. If you’re sacrificing your health for us, we’ll make sure you recover as much as possible."
Claire’s eyes widened slightly. "Kai... thank you."
Kai nodded at this, since if she grew stronger, it would also benefit him. But he was curious about one thing.
"Fifth Sin... Isn’t that Greed?"

Claire lowered her gaze. She had already thought of this before, but she never dwelled on it. "Yes... I suppose it does match. The more I hoard, the stronger I become. Food, weapons, valuables... it all feeds into the Talent."
The others exchanged uneasy glances.
Wallace scratched the back of his neck and muttered...
"Greed... huh. That actually makes sense. I mean, it explains why your strength skyrockets when you’ve got resources stacked up."
Now, Terrence also realized how good this Talent was.
"If there’s a Fifth Sin, then... what about the others? First Sin, Second Sin, all the way to Seventh? There must be more Epic Talent holders out there."
"Seven deadly sins, huh..." Ralph muttered.
The group fell silent for a moment, each imagining the possibilities. The idea of seven Epic‐grade Talents tied to sins was both fascinating and unsettling.
Claire sighed, as she had also thought about this before.
"I didn’t want to be defined by that word. Greed... However, it saved us today."
Kai gave a thumbs up and nodded.

"Names don’t matter. What matters is how you use it. You didn’t hoard for yourself anyway... You even saved us all. I can also help you with that Talent of yours and make you even stronger... You can be our best fighter, you know?"
Wallace chuckled, unable to hide a little jealousy. It couldn’t be denied that Claire’s Talent was incredible.
"I hope that the one using Wrath will not be our enemy..."
Kai laughed and shook his head.
"We’ll think about that later. For now, let’s take care of these things... We can’t let them go to waste."
As he said this, he gestured at the remains of the Sentinels, including the plasma rifles in their possession.
The group nodded. They began stripping the Sentinels’ bodies and collecting anything useful. Even damaged armor plates were pried off, stacked, and carried. Nothing was left behind.
They planned to return to Haven‐45 after this.

After all, the Sentinels wouldn’t just run out of power in a day or two. Even if the generator was gone, Kai believed that those older generations or D‐Grade Sentinels could still function for several days.
"Alright! Let’s get to work. I’m sure those guys in Haven‐45 are worried," Ralph said, knowing that Victor and the others were just praying for their safe return.
In the meantime, while the survivors regrouped in the sewer, the machines in the A.I. Base outside continued their programmed routines.
The generator was gone, and a huge part of the area was consumed by fire. Yet the Sentinels did not abandon the base!
After they put out the fire and cleaned the area, they actually stayed around. It was as if there was no protocol for retreat, no command to abandon the compound!

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Lurkers
paragraphs: Soon, Kai’s small group confirmed that no one was following them anymore.
With the cover of darkness and the help of their night‐vision goggles from Stealth Gift Packs, they moved swiftly through the ruined streets.
"This device is so cool. Why did I even select Weapons Gift Pack?" Terrence muttered as he couldn’t help but feel impressed with the night-vision goggles.
Although it was not comfortable to wear, he could easily adjust to it.
"Weapons Gift Pack is actually the best option. It can protect from both Survivors and Mechanical Soldiers to some extent." Wallace replied in a low voice.
"Maybe... But thanks a lot, Kai... I’ll do my best to contribute to your shelter. I’ll help you grow it big." Terrence said as he already knew that Kai was the key to prosperity!
Since his Pathfinder Talent was so limited and could only help him escape danger at most, he knew that he had to stick to the best Survivor out there.
Without a doubt, the Rank 1 in the Leaderboard would be the best option.
"Well... If you work hard, then I’ll also want you to stay in my team." Kai replied.
Just like that, they continued moving, and soon, they reached the dilapidated Haven‐45.
Relief washed over them as they prepared to share the good news that they had managed to destroy the enemy base’s source of electricity.
Inside Haven‐45, the survivors were thrilled as soon as they heard the news!
After all, they might really succeed in snatching that A.I. Army’s base!

Although it was only housing old-generation Sentinels, it was still an incredible achievement. It was something that Russel, Augustine, and many other original residents of Haven-45 had never even imagined before.
"That’s incredible..."
Aurora, one of the newer arrivals, listened quietly. She had been saved alongside Terrence and Jonas when Haven‐15 collapsed...
Although this new shelter didn’t have any Augmented Humans who could break a Sentinel’s head with their palms, this Haven-45 felt strangely safe for her.
"Aurora... Did you hear the news? We might be leaving this place soon." Irene, one of the nurses of the shelter, said as she patted her shoulder.
"Yes! I’m really excited. I hope everything works out."
"Don’t jinx it!"
"Ahh... Sorry about that!" Aurora covered her mouth as she also realized that she just raised a flag.
"Haha... I’m just joking... Anyway, how’s the plants so far?" Irene asked.
Though only Uncommon Rank, Aurora’s Plant Enthusiast Talent was invaluable.

She had been tasked with caring for their main source of food, the peanut plants growing in the lowest chamber of the underground shelter. The plants were fragile, but under her guidance, they thrived even more.
With her ability, she could accelerate growth, coaxing sprouts into sturdy stalks faster than nature alone allowed.
Soon, Aurora returned to her working area and knelt among the rows of plants...
Her hands brushed gently over the soil before she channeled her Spirit Points into the Talent.
After a few moments, a faint glow pulsed across the leaves of all the plants in the small field as their roots seemed to stretch deeper into the earth.
Just like that, thirty Spirit Points drained from her reserves. Still, the sight of healthier crops filled her with pride. Food meant survival, after all.
"Finally... Time to rest..."
After feeling tired, she left the chamber and made her way to the bathing area. Thankfully, this place was safe even after all the bombardment that this shelter endured.
However, the underground shelter’s facilities were crude... The pipes rattled, the water was cold, and privacy was also scarce.
Indeed, the water was called because the boiler was compromised after the Mech Siege’s bombardment.
Still, this could be endured and wasn’t a huge problem for Auroa.
She stripped off her camouflage suit, folding it neatly beside her, and stepped into the shallow basin.
The water was icy, but she welcomed it, since what was more important was the fact that it scrubbed away the sweat and grime of the day.
Then came the more awkward part.
Aurora washed her undergarments carefully, wringing them out with practiced movement.
It was a small but constant struggle...

Apparently, while they had spare camouflage suits and basic gear from their survival sets, they had no replacements for underwear. Everyone had to make do with the same pair, washing them daily and hoping they would dry in time.
She sighed, hanging the damp fabric on a line strung across the bathing area. "At least they’re clean," she murmured to herself.
It was a reminder of how fragile their comfort was, even the smallest necessities had become luxuries.
Despite the hardship, Aurora didn’t complain...
She knew her Talent wasn’t flashy, but it mattered. Every peanut plant she nurtured meant another day of survival for Haven‐45... at the very least, that was what she wanted to think.
The next morning, Wallace followed Kai’s instructions to leave early.
He chewed on a granola bar while fastening the straps of his camouflage suit. The taste was bland, but it was enough to keep him moving.
Then, he adjusted the belt of his survival set, checked the charge on his transceiver, and slipped out of Haven‐45 before most of the others were awake.
"Here we go..." Wallace muttered.
Apparently, it was his task to monitor the situation in the A.I. Base!
Still, he had to be careful since no reinforcements were coming.
Clank!
As soon as he opened the tunnel to leave the shelter, he was welcomed with the familiar pungent garbage field. However, he just ignored it and left the area.
Wallace moved cautiously, as he relied on his Swift Stride Skill to escape if needed.
Then, when he finally reached a vantage point overlooking the compound, he froze...
Another group of survivors was already there!
They lurked near the perimeter, scanning the wreckage, and observing the Sentinels!
Wallace couldn’t tell if they were scavengers, opportunists, or rivals, but he knew one thing... being spotted could mean trouble.
Without hesitation, he pulled back, retreating the way he came. Once he was far enough, he raised his transceiver and spoke in a low, urgent tone.
"Kai, this is Wallace. We’ve got company. Another group is sniffing around the A.I. base. I didn’t engage, I’m heading back now."

chapters.title: Chapter 69: The A.I. Base
paragraphs: Samantha finally agreed not to leave... at least not yet.
"Good decision..."
Kai was relieved, though he couldn’t help but feel a strange mix of emotions.
Her desperation was quite something else. It was unsettling, and yet impressive in its intensity.
’A little too desperate for sure...’ He mused.
She had actually been willing to risk everything for love, even to the point of offering herself for resources she could have earned through work.
It was certainly a reminder of how fragile hope was in this world, and how far people would go when they felt powerless.
Kai shook the thought away. He had no time to dwell on it...
Two more days passed. The situation in Haven‐45 wasn’t perfect, but it was stable.
Food and water were not lacking, thanks to his Talent, Aurora’s crops and Samantha’s Purifier Talent.
The shelter had enough to keep everyone fed, hydrated, and working. As he thought that he would need to wait a few more days, Russel and Augustine returned with their latest report.
Kai gathered his core team in the dimly lit command room, listening intently as Russel spoke.
"The one testing the A.I. base... it’s not just another survivor group," Russel explained.

"After several more investigations, we confirmed that it’s a man with a unique talent. He can turn humans into puppets... or maybe slaves that follow his every order. We saw him sacrifice ten people like they were nothing. Then, he continued to gather more, as if he were perfecting his craft. All his attempts to conquer the base failed, but we know he’s dangerous."

Augustine added, "We kept our distance. Observation was done farther away this time. We couldn’t risk being seen. But there’s more... several Sentinels have already stopped moving. We confirmed that their optics or sensors went dark. Only a handful are still active..."
The room fell silent. That was the main reason why they returned.
"I’ve been waiting for that..."
Kai muttered. It was a lot earlier than he had thought but the Operation Blackout was working.
The destruction of the electricity source was finally taking its toll. The old generation Sentinels were running out of power.
"They’re done for," Kai said quietly... There was a sense of satisfaction and urgency...
"The base is weakening. This is our chance... If we wait too long, that mind‐controller will take it instead. He’ll benefit from our hard work. We can’t allow that to happen, can we?"
Just like that, preparations began immediately. Kai ordered every able-bodied man and woman who could carry a gun to assemble.
Then, weapons and gears were distributed to everyone...
By nightfall, thirty-two survivors got ready, and they each wore a camouflage suit.

Every one of them carried two revolvers, twelve extra bullets, two smoke grenades, and a hatchet. Some had torches strapped to their belts, others even had simple Molotov cocktails... Well, they were crude but effective tools of chaos.
And of course, all of them wore night‐vision goggles... It was something that the mind-controller could never have.
At this point, they already knew that this person would only attack during the day...
So, moving at night was the best option they had to avoid clashing with them.
Kai walked among them, inspecting their gear, and also reminding them of their operation.

He knew many of them were not soldiers. They were farmers, scavengers, teachers, and laborers. But tonight, they were all fighters, and making mistakes here might result in someone losing their lives...
"No one acts alone. We fight as one, or we’ll die out there..." Kai said in the end.
The survivors nodded firmly as they knew how dangerous this was.
As the group prepared to leave, Kai looked back at the shelter.

Nine people remained behind, the nurses, the cooks, the sanitation crew, and a few others. Their task was to guard the scavenged resources within the shelter... The Sentinel parts, Hound fragments, and other valuable materials like the peanut plants need to be protected since Haven‐45 could not afford to lose them.
Of course, Kai was also worried about this mission. After all, he was leading thirty-two lives into danger...
But he pushed the doubt aside. This was the moment they had been waiting for!
Under the cover of night, the strike team departed.

Their camouflage blended with the darkness, while the night‐vision goggles made them see the world in shades of green. It was quite an interesting sight for many of them who had never used them before.
Then, after about an hour of walking, Kai stepped forward beside Russel and Augustine who were leading the group... He decided to lead from the front this time.
He knew the enemy base was close and there might be unexpected things to happen. With his Gene Skill, Keen Senses, he’d be able to detect danger much faster.
Soon, the strike team crept closer to the A.I. army’s base.

Their night‐vision goggles allowed them to scan every corner of the place and at first, they expected to see glowing optics or hear the mechanical movements of patrols. But as they swept the perimeter, they found nothing.
They found no active guards, no patrols, or any movement.
Russel whispered, "There’s nothing... no heat signatures at all."
Augustine adjusted his goggles, scanning again. "Confirmed. The machines are cold. Not even residual warmth from their cores. It’s like they all shut down at once."
The group exchanged uneasy glances.
Is that really it?
They thought to themselves. This was too hard to believe. After all, they felt before that the Sentinels could last months on internal reserves. Yet here they were, dead in just a few days.
Kai frowned, his Keen Senses also failed to detect any danger...
He felt no vibrations from the machinery or any signs of life. It was too quiet.
"This doesn’t add up," Kai muttered. "We can’t just march in blind. There might be traps, or something we’re not seeing."
He turned to Wallace and Claire. Wallace had Swift Stride Gene Skill while Claire had the Epic Talent. They should be skilled enough to escape if needed.
"You two, with me," Kai ordered. "We’ll scout the base first. The rest of you hold position here. Ralph, they charge here. Stay alert."
"Got it... Be careful." Ralph replied.
Just like that, Kai and the other left to check the base, unaware of the danger lurking around.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: The One Missing
paragraphs: Kai, Wallace, and Claire slowly moved forward as they didn’t want to make too much noise...
As they passed through the opened gate and entered the perimeter of the compound, their goggles revealed rows of frozen Sentinels, standing like statues.
Some of them had also collapsed entirely...
Still, there was one thing that Kai noticed. These Sentinels are already in bad condition. They have rusted armors, and even their rifles weren’t even the Plasma Rifles or any advanced ones!
They were just normal rifles, and this was a huge discovery in itself.
’This is perfect...’Kai mused.
However, the other two had different worries right now.
"It’s like they all died at once. They’re not going to move suddenly if we get closer, right?" Claire whispered.
Kai helplessly smiled at that since he also had no idea.
"We’ll know if we try to get closer. But I’m sure they’re already drained. The blackout hit harder than we thought. Their reserves didn’t last."
Wallace scanned the area... There were a few buildings that they must check... One of them should be the warehouse with captive humans if they were still alive.
As for the main building and the other one on the right, they were only for the A.I. Army, so they had no clue just yet.
"I don’t hear any movements from those areas as well... So the base is empty? Just like that?" Wallace frowned. He felt that this was too easy, and it was quite unsettling.
It felt like they were missing something.
Kai shook his head. "Empty doesn’t mean safe. We’ll sweep it carefully."
"Got it..."
Then, they moved deeper into the compound, passing silent watchtowers and abandoned barracks.
The central courtyard was also quite empty, but soon, they focused on the massive doors to the command building.
It slightly opened with an emergency light flickering faintly inside. It was quite impressive that it was still providing some light.
Kai raised a hand, signaling for silence. He stepped forward, with his pistol on hand...
He wanted to see if his Keen Senses would probe something but there was nothing...
The base was dead.
Kai exhaled slowly. "It’s clear," he said at last.
"The blackout worked better than we thought. The Sentinels are finished."
Wallace shook his head in disbelief. "So... it’s ours? Just like that?"
Kai paused...
"Not yet. We’ll secure it first. Then we’ll call the others in."
Claire glanced around uneasily. "It feels too easy. Like we’re walking into a trap."
Kai nodded. "Maybe. But if this base really is empty, then it’s the biggest victory we’ve had yet. And we can’t let that mind‐controller take it from us."
Just like that, more than thirty minutes immediately passed.
Outside, the twenty-nine survivors waited anxiously.
However, since there was no signal for help, gunshots, or any noise, Ralph dared not disobey Kai’s order to hold position.
Thankfully, after a few more minutes, they noticed some movements and confirmed that the three were all doing fine!
Then, when Kai, Wallace, and Claire returned with the news, disbelief rippled through the group...
"No guards?" Russel asked. "None at all?"

Kai nodded firmly. "None. The blackout crippled them faster than expected. The base is dead. We tried to check, and we found at least a hundred frozen Sentinels inside... We haven’t completed the exploration yet, but it should be faster if we all work together. We’ll sweep every building and every corridor faster..."
The survivors exchanged glances. Their fear had already turned into excitement. The A.I. base, once a fortress of two hundred Sentinels, now lay open before them.
This was unbelievable!
Then, as Kai was about to order them to sweep the A.I. Base with them, he noticed that someone was missing...
She had been with them when they left Haven‐45, one of the thirty-two who volunteered to fight. But now, as the survivors regrouped in the courtyard, her spot was empty.
Kai frowned.
’Did she actually--’ He couldn’t help but frown at her decision to leave.
After all, he knew how dangerous it was out there, and he may never see her again. Still, Samantha was already an adult and could decide for herself.
He then asked Ralph and the others, but they just confirmed that they didn’t Samantha leave as well.
"Let’s forget about her then." Kai muttered as the strike team moved, sweeping the compound building by building.
For a moment, it felt like victory. They found various tools, repair items, and others that could help them rebuild the shelter.
But then Kai’s instincts screamed. His Keen Senses picked up faint vibrations... There was no heavy thrum of machines, but the irregular rhythm of footsteps.
"Hold formation," Kai ordered as he confirmed the existence of enemies.
The survivors froze, scanning the perimeter outside... At first, the night‐vision goggles revealed only shadows. Then, figures began to emerge from the darkness beyond the compound walls.
Humans.
They moved slowly, and their faces were blank. Some carried blades, others scavenged rifles.
In the meantime, Russel’s clenched his fist as he realized what was going on.
"Mind‐controlled..."
Indeed, the mind‐controller had actually arrived this early!
Then Ralph shouted. There was panic in his voice. "Kai! Look!"
From the advancing line, a familiar figure stepped forward.
Samantha.
She had once begged for supplies to search for her boyfriend, but now, she was a puppet herself, stripped of her will, and was turned into a weapon against them.
"You’re too hasty..." Kai whispered.
He had no choice but to kill her now, or maybe find the one who cast the mind-control spell on her, and that seemed more difficult.

Kai sighed. He then watched and confirmed that her movements were rigid, and her eyes had already become lifeless. Her face was devoid of emotion, but still, she clutched a blade in her hand, probably as her weapon...
"She’s one of them now." Kai muttered again and shook his head. That woman was truly a problem from the start!
It also wouldn’t be surprising if Samantha had already revealed their movements, talents, and other information to whoever was controlling her right now!

He wanted to see if his Keen Senses would probe something but there was nothing...
The base was dead.
Kai exhaled slowly.
"It’s clear," he said at last.
"The blackout worked better than we thought.
The Sentinels are finished."
Wallace shook his head in disbelief.
"So... it’s ours?
Just like that?"
Kai paused...
"Not yet.
We’ll secure it first.
Then we’ll call the others in."
Claire glanced around uneasily.
"It feels too easy.
Like we’re walking into a trap."
Kai nodded.
"Maybe.
But if this base really is empty, then it’s the biggest victory we’ve had yet.
And we can’t let that mind‐controller take it from us."
Just like that, more than thirty minutes immediately passed.
Outside, the twenty-nine survivors waited anxiously.
However, since there was no signal for help, gunshots, or any noise, Ralph dared not disobey Kai’s order to hold position.
Thankfully, after a few more minutes, they noticed some movements and confirmed that the three were all doing fine!
Then, when Kai, Wallace, and Claire returned with the news, disbelief rippled through the group...
"No guards?" Russel asked.
"None at all?"
Kai nodded firmly.
"None.
The blackout crippled them faster than expected.
The base is dead.
We tried to check, and we found at least a hundred frozen Sentinels inside...
We haven’t completed the exploration yet, but it should be faster if we all work together.
We’ll sweep every building and every corridor faster..."
The survivors exchanged glances.
Their fear had already turned into excitement.
The A.I. base, once a fortress of two hundred Sentinels, now lay open before them.
This was unbelievable!
Then, as Kai was about to order them to sweep the A.I.
Base with them, he noticed that someone was missing...
She had been with them when they left Haven‐45, one of the thirty-two who volunteered to fight.
But now, as the survivors regrouped in the courtyard, her spot was empty.
Kai frowned.
’Did she actually--’ He couldn’t help but frown at her decision to leave.
After all, he knew how dangerous it was out there, and he may never see her again.
Still, Samantha was already an adult and could decide for herself.
He then asked Ralph and the others, but they just confirmed that they didn’t Samantha leave as well.
"Let’s forget about her then." Kai muttered as the strike team moved, sweeping the compound building by building.
For a moment, it felt like victory.
They found various tools, repair items, and others that could help them rebuild the shelter.
But then Kai’s instincts screamed.
His Keen Senses picked up faint vibrations...
There was no heavy thrum of machines, but the irregular rhythm of footsteps.
"Hold formation," Kai ordered as he confirmed the existence of enemies.
The survivors froze, scanning the perimeter outside...
At first, the night‐vision goggles revealed only shadows.
Then, figures began to emerge from the darkness beyond the compound walls.
Humans.
They moved slowly, and their faces were blank.
Some carried blades, others scavenged rifles.
In the meantime, Russel’s clenched his fist as he realized what was going on.
"Mind‐controlled..."
Indeed, the mind‐controller had actually arrived this early!
Then Ralph shouted.
There was panic in his voice.
"Kai!
Look!"
From the advancing line, a familiar figure stepped forward.
Samantha.
She had once begged for supplies to search for her boyfriend, but now, she was a puppet herself, stripped of her will, and was turned into a weapon against them.
"You’re too hasty..." Kai whispered.
He had no choice but to kill her now, or maybe find the one who cast the mind-control spell on her, and that seemed more difficult.
Kai sighed.
He then watched and confirmed that her movements were rigid, and her eyes had already become lifeless.
Her face was devoid of emotion, but still, she clutched a blade in her hand, probably as her weapon...
"She’s one of them now." Kai muttered again and shook his head.
That woman was truly a problem from the start!
It also wouldn’t be surprising if Samantha had already revealed their movements, talents, and other information to whoever was controlling her right now!

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Correct
paragraphs: "Get ready to fight! Don’t hesitate... They’re not going to listen to you." Kai reminded everyone as he brought the group to the window and watched the enemies approach.
Thankfully, all of them knew that they could not risk their own lives saving those strangers.
Suddenly, Kai noticed that the ones carrying guns raised their weapons!
Without hesitation, he also gave his command!
"Open fire!"
The survivors raised their revolvers, and just like that, the gunshots echoed through the compound!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Muzzle flashes lit the night as bullets tore into the advancing line of the listless or controlled humans.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The first wave or those humans in front fell quickly... Their crude blades and scavenged clubs were no match for disciplined volleys of gunfire.
It was not comparable at all.
Yet those who weren’t heavily injured and could still move just pressed forward without hesitation!
It was as if they could not feel pain... Even as their comrades collapsed beside them, they were stopping to move forward as if they couldn’t even see other things.
Kai’s heart tightened as he spotted Samantha among them.
He watched her move stiffly with her blade raised... Her face was devoid of emotion.

He had hoped, for a fleeting moment, that she might resist the control, that some spark of her old desperation and humanity would remain. But there was nothing. She was gone... although not dead, but enslaved, since her will was stripped away.
"Target them all!" Kai said, forcing himself to stay cold. "No hesitation!"
Well, he could probably order them to just subdue these underequipped people.
However, doing so could put those on his side at risk of injury.
He couldn’t just let those who trusted him get hurt. That would be the dumbest thing to do!
Samantha had her chance after he trusted her to join this raid.
However, because of her bad decisions, it ended up like this...
Soon, the survivors fired once again!
At this point, even Samantha staggered as a bullet struck her shoulder, yet she kept advancing with blade raised! They were like Zombies at this point!
Still, another shot hit her chest, and she collapsed to the ground, motionless. Kai exhaled as he noticed this...

In the end, Samantha remained under control by the enemy. Even after she got shot multiple times, she didn’t wake up at all. Whatever was controlling her, it seemed that it was something that could never be released through normal means.
"What a strong ability... Is this a Legendary Talent? Or maybe another triple S?" Kai frowned at this thought.
They didn’t even know how the mind‐control worked... If it was done through a parasite, brainwashing, or some other Talent.
All they knew was that these people were enemies now, and hesitation meant death.
Russel reloaded quickly.
"There’s more coming! But they’re just humans! Keep your distance!"
Soon, grenades were thrown as smoke filled the courtyard, obscuring the survivors’ positions.
After all, they had no idea about the clear number of the enemies!
"I thought there was a limit to the number of people he can control? Is he actually just hiding the real limit?" Kai was confused.
According to Russel’s observations, the man should only be able to control 10 or so humans. However, it was clearly different now since they had already eliminated at least 20 people!
But there were still more than 20 people outside!
’Just where is he getting all these poor people?!’Kai was confused. However, he also realized that there must be nearby shelters around
Still, he had to continue moving!
The strike team used their camouflage suits to blend into the shadows, firing from cover while the mind-controlled Survivors charged blindly forward.
But the few who were carrying rifles managed to return fire!
Bang! Bang!
Bodies fell one after another, but at the same time, the survivors gained experience points with each kill. Perhaps, even their Gene Skills were probably getting more mastery points...
’This can’t go on...’
Kai crouched behind a collapsed Sentinel, firing two shots into the chest of a charging man.
[ +150 Experience Points ]
Thud!
Kai continued doing this a couple of times before he decided to do something more.
’That guy controlling them must be somewhere here...’
The controlled humans weren’t acting alone. Someone was surely guiding them, orchestrating their movements from nearby.
He glanced at Claire, who had taken cover beside him. He mentioned his plan to her, and she immediately agreed.
She met his gaze and nodded. "He must be watching then."
Kai smiled... "That’s right... So we have to find this person."
Leaving Russel and Ralph to command the survivors, Kai and Claire slipped away from the main fight.
Their camouflage suits blended with the night and they moved silently. They circled the battlefield, using the chaos as cover.
Just like that, gunfire and screams masked their footsteps as they crept along the perimeter.
"He won’t be far. He definitely needs to see them, to control them." Claire whispered.
Kai agreed. His Keen Senses picked up faint vibrations around him and soon, he sensed a heartbeat...
It was steady and calm, unlike the frantic rhythm of battle. Someone was standing still, observing!
"Follow me..."
They moved closer, beyond the collapsed outpost...
’He’s here...’
Kai finally spotted him.
A lone figure was watching the slaughter silently... His eyes were glowing red and seemed unbothered by their obvious presence!
Without a doubt, this person was the mastermind.
Kai froze for a moment... Then, he raised his pistol!
They had to eliminate this person!
He steadied his aim, but before he could fire, the figure smirked!
In an instant, his body split... not into smoke or illusion, but into perfect duplicates.
Two, then four, identical versions of the mastermind stepped forward from the rubble!
Claire was shocked. "What? He even has that ability? Clones... He’s multiplying himself!"
Thankfully, Kai’s Gene Skill allowed him to find out the truth!
Without hesitation, he fired and shot the real one easily!
"You?! How!"

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Rewards
paragraphs: Alex couldn’t believe it...
He felt a pain in his chest as he staggered backward... He immediately clutched his chest as blood seeped through his fingers.
His vest actually failed to stop the gunshot...
Soon, his clones started fading, and in a few more seconds, they all dissolved into nothingness. The smirk that had once curled his lips was gone, replaced by bitterness and indignation.
He couldn’t understand it. He was supposed to be the chosen one of this apocalypse. The protagonist. The man destined to rise above the chaos and bend the world to his will.
How could this be happening?
His mind couldn’t process it...

He had only just begun. He was only Level 9, still early, still weak compared to what he knew he could become. His Talent was extraordinary, his control over minds unmatched with his Legendary Talent.
Apparently, he had already enslaved many people, far beyond the limits Russel had guessed. And his Gene Skill to clone himself was proof of his uniqueness.
He was supposed to grow stronger. At higher levels, his control would spread like wildfire, consuming entire shelters, entire armies. He would have ruled this apocalypse.
But now...
Now he was bleeding out on the cold ground, staring up at the night sky.
’That woman... I never should have trusted her.’Alex thought.

He thought of Samantha, the woman he had found wandering alone. She had been his stroke of luck. Through her, he learned of Haven‐45, of its leader named Kai, of their plan to seize the A.I. Base, and the fact that they should be busy fighting against the remaining Sentinels.
Even if Kai and the others won, they should be very exhausted, and he could easily win.
Of course, he expected Kai’s team to be strong as well but even if he failed, he could just escape with his clones and try again next time...
He had thought himself clever... But he had never considered Kai’s Gene Skill at all...
And now, that figure stood before him, pistol raised, and was looking at him coldly.
Alex’s breath came ragged. "Why... why you...?" His voice was weak and it was starting fading.
Kai didn’t answer. He didn’t need to.
Alex couldn’t help but curse as he looked at the sky...
’I was destined for greatness. I was supposed to be the one. This world was mine...’
Then, the barrel of the pistol flashed...
Bang!
Darkness swallowed him.
[ +350 Experience Points ]
Kai lowered his weapon and exhaled slowly. "We’re done here."

As he said this, he also confirmed that the remaining people under the man’s control regained their senses, but it didn’t take long before they died... It seemed that the man’s talent wasn’t just a simple mind-control...
It seemed closer to puppetry or perhaps reanimation. Unfortunately, he would never know the truth since the man was already dead.
"That talent is a lot more dangerous than I thought."
Kai sighed as he looked down at the corpse of the mind‐controller, the man who had nearly undone them with his twisted Talent.
He knew very well that if this person had been given more time, if he had reached higher levels, his control could have spread unchecked. He could have enslaved hundreds, maybe thousands.
It was a good thing that he was eliminated now, before his power matured.
Kai turned to Claire, who stood silently beside him, her pistol still in hand.
"Should we loot him?" He asked.
"Ahhh... You can do that..." Claire said, waving her hand.
Kai nodded and crouched beside the corpse... His expression was cold but focused. This apocalypse had truly changed him. If it were back on Earth, he wouldn’t be this calm at all.
"He must have decent resources."
He then pulled a worn satchel from Alex’s side. He opened it carefully, and the familiar System notifications appeared in his view as he pulled out some items...
[ Item Obtained: Combat Blade ]
[ Description: A fine steel blade. ]
[ Item Obtained: Smith & Wesson Model 10 ]
[ Description: A six-shot .38 Special revolver with 2 remaining bullets. ]
[ Item Obtained: Hemostatic Vial ]
[ Description: A concentrated medical solution that rapidly clots bleeding and accelerates wound closure. Restores moderate health when consumed. ]
[ Item Obtained: Endurance Tonic ]
[ Description: A bitter herbal extract mixed with stimulants. Reduces fatigue and enhances stamina, lasting up to 12 hours. ]
"Ohhh? Did he also get the Enhanced Medical Gift pack?" Kai muttered after seeing the last two medicines.
After all, his enhanced First Aid Kit had these items as well. He had no idea how he got it, but it was most likely a reward from the system.
Anyway, Kai continued checking and found two more incredible items!
[ Item Obtained: Prime Gene Enhancement Serum ]
[ Description: A rare genetic resource. Permanently increases base stats upon consumption. Small chance of awakening a Gene Skill. ]
[ Item Obtained: Talent Amplification Elixir ]
[ Description: Temporarily increases Talent effectiveness by 100% for 14 days. Extremely rare consumable. ]
"Finally... A new type of gene enhancement..." Kai muttered as he confirmed that it was still a full vial!
This was an incredible find!
It seemed to be similar to the Alpha Version, but it didn’t matter. What was more important was the fact that it was a different type!
Furthermore, Kai also liked the last elixir. It was definitely a system-reward item... and perhaps this was the reason why the man he just killed could control so many people at once!
"A Talent Amplification Elixir... so that’s how he was able to grow faster."
Claire leaned closer and soon, she also learned what it could do...
"Fourteen days of boosted Talent power. This is incredible... I wonder how he even got this thing..."
Kai chuckled as he gripped the vials tightly. "Good thing we ended him now..."
Just like that, the two completed their loot and walked back toward the courtyard, where the other survivors were gathering among the fallenpuppets.
Russel stepped forward and asked, "Is it over?"
Kai was about to answer, but suddenly, they heard a high‐pitched whine above them...
The survivors froze.
The sound grew louder, and it became more obvious what it was!
Without a doubt, they were drones in the sky!
They knew that sound all too well.
"Swarmers?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 73: The Secrets of the Base
paragraphs: "Hide!" Kai reminded everyone.

At once, everyone scattered, slipping into the cover of nearby buildings. They pressed themselves against walls, crouched behind rubble, and killed every light source. The compound fell into silence. There was only the sound of the drones above them...
The insect-like machines swept across the sky, and their sensor probably started scanning for movement.
Everyone held their breath.
Thankfully, the Swarmers did not descend for a thorough inspection.
Instead, they just passed overhead, moving between the buildings. The searchlights they’re using weren’t even that great, and because of that, they could barely get a better view of the surroundings.
Kai’s heart pounded. He knew what these machines meant.
Swarmers were scouts, and basically the ones who could call for a raid of Sentinels.
If they marked a target, the area would soon be swarmed by mechanical soldiers.
But tonight, the darkness was their ally. The survivors remained hidden, and after a few minutes, the drones moved on to search in another place...
During all this time, no one dared to speak.
Only after fifteen long minutes of inactivity, did they confirm that the Swarmers had truly left...
"We’re saved..."
The survivors exhaled in unison. They all felt revealed.
If the Swarmers had detected them, this base would have been overrun within the hour.
Kai straightened and looked at everyone. "We’re safe... for now."
With the threat gone, the survivors regrouped. This base would be their new home.
There was no electricity since the generator had been destroyed during Operation Blackout to ensure the Sentinels lost power. However, none of them were worried.
They even confirmed that every window was sealed, no light leaking outside. Only then did they remove their night‐vision goggles and begin exploring with the flashlight they had!
Indeed, each flashlight came from the Shelter Gift Packs Kai had opened.
Just like that, thirty-two beams of light cut through the darkness, illuminating the silent halls.
The sight was eerie. Dozens of unmoving Sentinels stood frozen with their frames locked in place... They were lifeless without power...
"I wonder... can we try to dismantle them or destroy their cores and still get experience points?" Wallace mused as he looked at the other Survivors.
Ralph nodded. "There are more than a hundred of them here. If the System recognizes it as a kill, we’d gain a fortune in points."
Kai frowned, uncertain by the answer as well... "Only one way to find out."
Some survivors gathered around a single Sentinel unit. Its mechanical body looked impressive, and it felt as if it would just move at any time...
Kai then looked around and confirmed that the others were just looking around the building with their flashlight on.
"Alright, the others can just continue exploring the place... But let’s take this one apart. Carefully."
"Nice!" Victor said as he rubbed his hands.
Soon, tools scraped against steel as he pried open the casing and sparks flashed as wires were severed.
"This one looks really old..." Victor said as he volunteered to work on this. With his experience, it didn’t take long before he reached the core, energy source, or perhaps its processing unit.
It seemed dull, empty shell.
But as Victor drove a blade into it, a faint pulse of energy rippled outward. There was definitely power in that core.
Then, the system responded instantly.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (E) ]
[ +90 Experience Points ]
There was no mention that it was a distributed experience point!
It means that the experience points were his alone, and he immediately informed the others about it.
Of course, they did it again, and this time, they all participated in the dismantling of the Sentinel.
But something unexpected happened! They didn’t even have to destroy the core, and they got the notification!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (E) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +30 Experience Points ]
The experience was very low since many of them joined in, and also because the Sentinel was only E-Grade...
Still, they all realized something important.

It seemed that even if they don’t destroy the core, as long as they dismantle more than 80% of the enemy soldiers to the point that they could no longer function, it would count as the enemy unit being destroyed!

Of course, this wasn’t completely proven yet. After all, they might’ve just destroyed some important wiring, the main circuit board, or some other crucial parts to make the unit unable to function anymore.

However, this was already an important piece of information, and with so many Sentinels lying around, they should have no problems experimenting on them until they could fully understand how the Sentinels work or how they could be destroyed easily.

"I got experience points too! I just yanked off three of its fingers."

Ralph chuckled, shaking his head. "Then we’ve got ourselves a gold mine."

Three armored vehicles!
