chapters.title: Chapter 84: The Augmented Humans
paragraphs: "A map?" Kai repeated, as he didn’t expect to get such a promising item
"Yes! It’s not a complete map, but you’ll have a general idea of your location. The terrain and the surrounding shelters as well." Santiago explained.
"Map, huh... I’m not really interested." Kai replied as he recalled that there should also be a map in the workshop before.
Seeing Kai’s uninterested expression, they soon realized that he was a tough opponent and it would be difficult for them to bleed him out of his resources.
Realizing that, Diego could only proceed with the previous plan. He tapped the jammer lightly, as he decided to explain it further...

"It has a range of about two hundred meters, enough to cover your shelter’s perimeter or a small battlefield. Once activated, it can disrupt AI communications for roughly fifteen minutes before it overheats. That window is often the difference between reinforcements arriving or not."
However, Kai still shook his head. "Nah... I think that 40 canned goods and 50 instant noodle pack is quite enough."

Santiago then added... "That’s too low... This jammer runs on a compact energy cell, the kind you can recharge with scavenged cores but hard to find. Anyway, one cell gives you three uses before it burns out. We brought a spare, but even without it, the device is efficient. It doesn’t drain power like the larger military jammers."
Kai smiled as he noticed that they were just trying hard and being greedy. Perhaps, this thing wasn’t even that rare at all.
’It’s difficult to trust people...’ Kai mused. He knew that he wouldn’t just accept the price they gave.
"And yet, you came here to trade, not to leave empty-handed. If you ask for everything, you’ll get nothing. Fifty canned goods and fifty noodles... that’s fair."
Santiago frowned. "Too low."
Kai smiled. "Alright. You win! Fifty canned goods... and sixty noodles. Final offer. You know as well as I do that food is precious nowadays. Are you still going to negotiate?"
The merchants exchanged a long look.
Finally, Diego sighed and gave a reluctant nod. "Fine. Sixty and sixty. The jammer is yours."
"Fifty and Sixty..." Kai repeated.
"Alright... Let’s go with that." Santiago finally said.
Relief spread through the hall as the first transaction was finally made.
Victor grinned, already imagining how to integrate the device into their defenses.
As Kai accepted the deal, he finally turned and asked.
"Now... tell me more about the AI Army. You said you could share information... What exactly do you know about their rebellion?"
"I know a lot of things. Hmm... How about the instigator of this A.I. Rebellion, the Anima Civilization? Are you aware of it?"
Kai froze. He certainly heard something quite similar from the previous head of the Haven-45 before he took his own life.
"Tell me more about it."
Just like that, Kai and the others heard the truth about this apocalypse...
Still, they have many questions in their minds.
They wanted to ask more about the other enemy units, like the Spyder and Field Tyrant.

However, the ground suddenly trembled beneath their feet. At first, it was subtle... just a faint vibration that made the curtains sway. But within seconds, the tremor grew into a violent quake that rattled the walls of New Haven‐45.
Even dust fell from the ceiling, and several survivors cried out in alarm.
"Earthquake?!" Wallace shouted, bracing himself against the wall.
Kai frowned at this since his Keen Senses was telling otherwise.
’No... this isn’t natural.’
Before anyone could recover, a deafening explosion echoed from the distance. Then another.
Boom! Boom!
The rumble of collapsing structures carried across the land and it was actually followed by flashes of light that lit up the horizon.
The hall erupted in commotion. Survivors rushed to the windows, straining to see what was happening outside.
Victor immediately shared what he knew.
"Those aren’t just explosions... that’s a battle!"

Indeed, far beyond the shelter’s perimeter, figures clashed... There were five warriors moving with inhuman speed, and their bodies were glowing faintly with energy. Each strike they delivered actually shook the earth...
It didn’t end there since each leap from the five carried them across impossible distances!
Diego and Santiago froze, their expressions shifted from calm merchants to speechless observers
"Augmented Humans..." Santiago whispered, almost reverently. "They’re here."
Kai turned to him and felt a little bit excited. "Augmented Humans?"
Although he already knew about their existence, he might as well get some new and free information from the woman!

Diego’s voice trembled. "Yes. Augmented Humans. They’re not like us. They’re humans who underwent underground, high-grade Gene Enhancements. Basically, they’re legends among survivors. We respect them deeply... they’re the pinnacle of human evolution."
Just like that, the survivors stared in awe as the five Augmented Humans fought against the enemy.
Boom!
From the smoke emerged another human-sized machine, unlike any Kai had ever seen.
Its frame was shiny. It was reinforced with black alloy, and its eyes were crimson light. Every step it took sent shockwaves through the ground.
Then, Diego’s face went pale. "No... it can’t be."
"What is that thing?" Claire demanded, gripping her weapon tightly.
Diego’s voice cracked as he shouted, "Why is an Ascendant Unit here?! They should be in the central continent!"
The survivors exchanged confused glances.
Ascendant?
They had no idea what the term meant, but judging by Diego’s horror, it was something far beyond the Sentinels or Tyrants they had faced.
Soon, they watched as the five Augmented Humans charged at the Ascendant Unit. Even their movements blurred as they unleashed everything they had.
Energy blasts lit up the sky while blades clashed against their armor or shield! Just like that, shockwaves rippled across the battlefield.
Yet the Ascendant barely retreated!
It raised one of its arms, releasing a beam of destructive energy that carved a trench into the earth!
Boom!
"What the-- This is dangerous. He might lure the enemy here!" Aurora clutched her basket and worriedly looked at the battle...
Kai’s mind raced.
’If it comes this way, New Haven‐45 won’t stand a chance.’

chapters.title: Chapter 85: Something Wrong
paragraphs: The ground outside the New Haven-45 trembled as the five Augmented Humans pushed their assault.
Kai could barely follow their movements despite having a Level 3 Keen Senses.
Still, he was able to see blades of energy carving through the Ascendant’s armor. Then, there were shockwaves booming across the land, and explosions would even light the sky from time to time.
Yet the Ascendant Unit was still functioning!
Its black alloy body absorbed blow after blow!
With a single sweep of its arm, it unleashed a beam that vaporized everything in its path. Thankfully, the Ascendant Units targeted the opposite side of their shelter instead.
"Shit... They’re dying!"
"Oh no!"
"They’ve messed up. They should’ve just escaped."
Apparently, one Augmented Human was caught mid-leap. The blast tore through his chest, and he fell lifeless to the ground!
Despite being higher level and perhaps consuming more types of Gene Enhancement Serums, their flesh was still incapable of blocking such advanced weapons!
"Damn it!" Santiago shouted, gripping the window frame as the merchants watched in horror. They knew very well that if the Augmented Humans died, they could be next!
Still, the remaining four fought harder. They were filled with rage after seeing one of them perish.
But the Ascendant Unit was one of the strongest Mech Soldiers of the Anima Civilization for a reason.

Soon, a second warrior was crushed beneath its foot, his body shattered instantly after barely destroying a part of its leg. Thankfully, he at least managed to hold the Ascendant’s leg tightly and made the unit incapable of moving!
"Die!"
Another one tried to use this chance to eliminate the enemy with a glowing spear, to ensure that the sacrifice of the two wouldn’t be in vain... but the Ascendant’s claws suddenly ripped through him!
It happened so quickly!
Kai’s group stood frozen...
Three Augmented Humans, legends among survivors, had fallen in mere minutes.
But the last two ignored the deaths of their companions as they knew that the enemy unit was already badly damaged!
"Haaa!"
Their bodies were filled with spirit energy, and they launched a coordinated strike. One distracted the Ascendant with endless sword strikes, while the other drove a blade deep into its core.
Boom!
The Ascendant tried to remove the blade but it was already too late!
Sparks erupted from its chest, and in a few moments, it collapsed, shaking the earth as its frame crashed into the ruins.
Silence followed, broken only by the crackle of burning debris.
Kai’s eyes widened.They... they actually defeated it.

The two surviving Augmented Humans stood over the wreckage, their faces looked grim. They probably didn’t expect to suffer so much from that battle against a single Ascendant Unit. Still, they salvaged the Ascendant’s weapons and cores... but to Kai’s surprise, they left the rest of its body untouched.
"They’re not taking the parts?" Victor also muttered in disbelief.
Diego nodded as he rubbed his palms. This was an opportunity!
"They only take what they need..."

Then, it was at this point that the two Augmented Humans glanced toward New Haven‐45. For a moment, their eyes locked with Kai’s group. Then, without a word, they lifted the bodies of their fallen comrades and vanished into the horizon, leaving the battlefield littered with Ascendant remains.
Kai’s heart pounded.This is our chance.
"Move!" he shouted. "Gather a team. We’re taking those parts before anyone else does!"

The survivors sprang into action... Wallace and Jonas led their team, while Victor waited patiently, preparing his tools. After all, he knew very well that he’d be the one working on it... He was already eager to dismantle the Ascendant’s frame!

The merchants, however, were less pleased. Diego clenched his teeth to suppress his jealousy while Santiago clenched his fist... They wanted the parts too, but this was Kai’s territory. They could only watch as his people claimed the spoils.
Kai had no idea how this loot could change his shelter, but he would welcome any changes that it could bring to his shelter!
It didn’t take that long before the team that had gone to recover the Ascendant’s remains finally returned.
Their carts were loaded with scavenged armor plating, fractured weapon fragments, and shards of black alloy.
Victor’s eyes gleamed as he inspected the haul, already imagining how to repurpose the materials.
Then, with the loot secured, Kai wasn’t in a hurry as he turned back to the traders, so they could already leave...

Transactions were completed quickly. He didn’t purchase any serums from Diego and Santiago, but he traded rolls of fabric and other supplies for practical goods aside from the Portable Signal Jammer that he negotiated earlier.

Still, not everyone followed Kai’s restraint. Claire, who had three Survivor Medals, and Wallace, who had two, decided to pool their resources. Together, they purchased the Emerald Gene Enhancement Serum. It was agreed Wallace would consume it first, strengthening his bones and muscles to better protect the shelter. Next time, Claire would have priority.
Terrence and Jonas did the same as they combined their Survivor’s Medals to get the serum they wanted.
Of course, the two traders tried purchasing the remnants of the Ascendant Unit from them...
They actually offered a half-filled vial of Alpha Gene Enhancement Serum plus some items in their current pack.
They really wanted the Ascendant materials that Wallace had recovered outside. But Kai refused firmly, thanking them for their trade before making it clear the wreckage belonged to New Haven‐45.
Diego’s smile faded, and Santiago could only stare at the room where they were keeping the body.
At last, with no more business to conduct, the two of them and their escorts could only leave the place... They still had many other shelters they had to visit.
Just like that, their white flags fluttered briefly in the wind before disappearing into the horizon.
Soon, Kai joined Victor and the others who were already tearing apart the remains of the Ascendant Unit.
In just a few hours, Victor was able to dismantle everything, even with his simple tools. His Mechanic Talent was certainly the real deal.
"This black alloy is awesome... We can probably use these parts to make some swords or blades." Victor muttered as he could tell how tough they were.
Then, as he looked behind to hear Kai’s opinion, he suddenly noticed that Atom was walking towards him, or perhaps, towards the remains of the Ascendant!
’What?! Did I do something wrong?’

chapters.title: Chapter 88: The Field Tyrant
paragraphs: The reminder message faded, leaving the mess hall in tense silence. No one was surprised since they had been warned ten days ago. But now, the countdown was over. The Field Tyrants were active, and they felt a little anxious since they had no idea how dangerous this could be.
Kai stood and looked at everyone in the hall. "It’s begun. Stay sharp. We’ll confirm if any Tyrants are near our zone."
The survivors nodded.
They had drilled for this moment, but being in this situation now felt different... There was a lot more pressure now since any mistake could cost them their lives.
Still, they had made various plans to deal with this problem...
They had enough guns and ammunition. They have enough food and weapons, so they should be just fine as long as they follow Kai’s strategies.
Soon, the scouts led by Russel started checking the surroundings.
For a while, there was nothing. No alarms, no tremors, no sign of mechanical giants approaching. The uncertainty gnawed at them.
Then, the radio crackled.
Russel’s voice came through, and he sounded so urgent.

"Leader... I’ve spotted movements. I didn’t dare get close, their scanners might detect me. But I’ve got the general location. It’s near the broken cell tower, northeast. We passed through it when we first moved here."
Soon, the information was shared with everyone...
They all remembered that tower, and it was close! It was only about 500 meters away from them.
Kai’s expression hardened. "Understood. Team A, Team B... with me. We’ll check it out."
Ralph’s ranged unit and Claire’s close‐combat squad assembled quickly with their weapons ready. They were the Assault Teams he had arranged before.
Jonas and Wallace, on the other hand, reinforced the perimeter since they couldn’t just leave this place unattended.
After all, during these times, the A.I. Army wasn’t their only opponent. They still had to worry about the greedy Survivors lurking around.
"We’ll protect this place, Sir Kai! Don’t worry!" Jonas said after seeing Kai preparing to leave.
"I trust you..." Kai replied with a smile.
Just like that, he ordered Atom to follow him.
Then, he looked at the two teams... Team A, under Ralph’s lead, had 10 people... As for Team B under Claire’s lead, it only had 8 people, but Terrence was included here.

At this time, Victor, who shouldn’t be part of the Assault Teams, also strapped on his gear, eager to see what kind of machine awaited them. His specialty as a Mechanic might be needed since they’d be facing a new type of enemy units.
"Let’s go!" Kai said as he confirmed that everyone was ready.
Just like that, the group moved cautiously as they left the shelter. They then started following Russel’s directions.
After some time, the broken cell tower appeared ahead of them.
They reached a stretch of collapsed highway that overlooked the ruins of the broken cell tower. The frame of the tower was like a rusted spear. Its bent beams were even creaking faintly in the wind.
Kai crouched, signaling the others to halt.
From their vantage point, they had a clear view of the area.
And then they saw it.
The Field Tyrant stood among the ruins...
"Whoa~"
"That’s huge..."
"How are we supposed to destroy the thing?"
"Sshh... Silence!"
It was a towering mech nearly six meters tall. Its frame was bulky and their revolvers were definitely useless against it!
It had thick armor plates welded together in several layers, as if scavenged from countless other machines.
Thud... Thud... Thud...
Each step it took made the ground shudder, sending vibrations through the cracked pavement.
Still, they noticed that this Field Tyrant seemed to be a badly made humanoid mech. It was unlike Atom that looked flawless.

"Probably made by Aria rather than the Anima Civilization," Kai guessed. He remembered that Aria was the human-created A.I. that had rebelled, while the Anima Civilization was the one that came from another realm and had manipulated Aria into turning against humanity.
Based on their assumptions, the C-Grade or lower-grade enemy units were most likely made by Aria, while the high-grade ones were made by the Anima Civilization.
In short, this Field Tyrant didn’t seem to be that high-grade after seeing its build.

Apparently, its arms were enormous, one ending in a clawed hand capable of crushing vehicles, while the other was fitted with a heavy cannon instead. Along its shoulders were uneven armored plating extended outward like shields, and from its back rose a cluster of antennae and sensor arrays...
Of course, it was still dangerous, but it didn’t look like a polished Mech Unit.
"This might be doable..." Terrence muttered.
"It’s huge but...it looked imbalanced," Claire commented.
The machine moved unevenly since its left leg was shorter as well/.
Still, around the Field Tyrant were Sentinel escorts patrolling in tight formation. There were only nine of them, but they weren’t easy to deal with.
They were still about 2 meters tall after all.
Furthermore, they carried rifles integrated into their arms as if expecting an ambush.
Victor couldn’t help but clench his fist as he saw this...
"That’s it, huh... the Field Tyrant. That thing looked terrifying. It’s also a bit too massive for us... How are we supposed to destroy that thing?"
"I’m curious about that too... I wonder how the others will deal with this."
"Well, they’ll probably think of escaping. Anyway, the mission also mentioned that we can just try and survive for 10 days, and we’ll get a reward."
Many of them had similar thoughts.

Even from this distance, the machine’s presence was suffocating. It wasn’t just its size, it was the way it dominated the ruins, as if the cell tower and the surrounding area had already become its territory.
Kai then o took a deep breath...
’It moves slowly... It should be possible, right?’
As he thought this, he looked at Atom, which was ready to strike down at his command.
Then, he turned to Russel.
"So... Russel, did you find the Spyder Rangers?"

chapters.title: Chapter 89: The Secrets of the Boiler Room
paragraphs: "Yes, Leader. Three of them. They weren’t moving with the Sentinels. Instead, they stayed farther back, positioned on the rubble and the tower itself. Ahhh--They just slipped away. They’re behind that ruined building..." Russel said as he pointed to one of the buildings about 200 meters away from the Field Tyrant!
It means that their weapon range was roughly this distance.

"Each one’s equipped with a long-barreled weapon. Looked like rifles built into their frames. They’re covering the Tyrant from that range... This is just like what you’ve imagined, Leader." Russel muttered as he looked at Kai with reverence.

Apparently, during their strategy meetings, Kai already planned something for this type of situation. He even thought that there could be more than ten Spyder Rangers, but thankfully, there were only three of them! This should be doable!
Kai gently nodded as he heard this...

That explained the formation of the enemy’s defense. The nine Sentinels formed the close escort, circling the Tyrant like bodyguards, while the three Spyders acted as overwatch, scanning the horizon and locking down any approach with suppressive fire.
Victor muttered, "I guess they’re A.I. Army for a reason. They’re not just brute force. They’ve set up a proper formation..."
Claire nodded. "If we rush in without any plans, the Sentinels will pin us down, and the Spyders will pick us off before we even reach the Tyrant."
Kai took a slow breath, studying the ruined cell tower. Then, he looked at the Field Tyrant that was six meters tall...
It was within his considerations.
’We can do this... We just need to stick to the plan and act accordingly...’
Crash~
Suddenly, they watched as the Field Tyrant’s claw gripped one of the broken cars and began crushing it.
This confused everyone as it seemed as if the Field Tyrant was playing. After all, it shouldn’t have any purpose for doing this...

Nonetheless, they stayed quiet as they watched the metal frame of the car shriek under the pressure. Then, the windows started shattering, and soon, they heard the steel folding in on itself like paper. With a final squeeze, the vehicle was reduced to a mangled cube of twisted panels and broken axles.
Then, with a grinding hiss, the chest of the Field Tyrant split open. Plates slid apart to reveal a furnace-like cavity glowing with a dull, orange light!
The claw lifted the compressed wreckage and shoved it inside.
The survivors froze, horrified by what they had just witnessed.
"What the hell...?" Victor whispered as he didn’t expect this scene at all.

Inside the cavity, mechanical arms seized the crushed car, dragging it deeper into the furnace. Sparks erupted as the cube scraped against the gears. A roar of flame followed, licking across the metal.
The car’s remains glowed red, then white, as the heat devoured it.
Claire’s eyes widened. "It’s... burning it. Like fuel."
The group watched in disbelief as the cube began to disintegrate.
The furnace’s inner walls pulsed, and the vents opened to draw in the heat and vapor. It was such an intriguing sight!
Russel swallowed hard.
Victor whispered, "It’s feeding itself... turning scrap into energy. That furnace... I think it’s similar to the ones in the boiler room."
"What?" Kai’s eyes widened.
It was the same for Ralph and the others as their eyes widened.
Kai remembered the mysterious boiler room of Haven‐45. It was in the hidden chamber that had kept the shelter alive for years.

At that time, it wasn’t just wood or waste and other materials that fueled it. Even the corpses of fallen members had been carried there, their bodies consumed by the furnace to keep the shelter running.
Kai had always found the place interesting because of that strange method.

Russel and others had also once told him that the furnace itself hadn’t been built by the survivors. It had come from an A.I. base long ago, salvaged and installed by the original founders of Haven‐45.
Kai had never visited the boiler room himself, but he had heard enough stories to know its importance.

Previously, he had intended to see it for himself, but the chance never came. Duties kept him busy, and the heat inside was said to be suffocating. He thought there would be time later since he planned to make the Haven-45 his base...
Unfortunately, the Mech Siege’s bombardment had destroyed much of Haven‐45, and among the losses was the boiler room itself.

Now, hearing Victor’s words and watching the Field Tyrant consume wreckage, Kai felt a chill. The resemblance was undeniable, not because he had seen the boiler with his own eyes, but because the stories matched perfectly.
The same technology that had sustained Haven‐45 was actually from a Field Tyrant or similar enemy units!
"Interesting... Maybe that furnace can also be used to power up our shelter?" Claire muttered.
"That would be great. We need electricity too..." Ralph said.
"Yes... I’m also worried that Atom might stop functioning really soon." Kai said as this was certainly one of his main concerns.
He had no idea about Atom’s operation time!
Crash!
Soon, another car was destroyed and was dissolved by the furnace...
Still, they continued to watch as they needed to gather information about their target.
Then, they watched as the Field Tyrant started moving faster... It no longer had stiff movements like before...
For some reason, the entire mech seemed to shudder with renewed vigor, its uneven steps were actually stabilizing slightly.
Kai’s jaw tightened. "So that’s how it sustains itself... scavenging machines, consuming them like fuel."
The survivors exchanged uneasy glances. The realization was chilling... the ruins around them weren’t just debris. They were resources, waiting to be devoured by this mechanical predator.
Ralph clenched his fists. "If it can keep feeding like that... It’ll keep growing stronger."
"No way... There must be a limit, right? It’s just a machine..." Victor immediately said.
Kai frowned as he looked behind him
"I don’t think we can wait anymore... We’ve seen enough... We should begin the subjugation before things get out of control."

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Field Tyrant Hunt
paragraphs: Kai believed that they had a chance to win this...

If this were unwinnable, he would immediately order his people to just hide and escape from them. However, with Atom on their side and the various combat strategies they formed... He knew that they had at least 70% chance or more of succeeding in this operation.
He turned to Ralph. "We’ll proceed with the plan... Your assault team will target the Spyders first. They’re the eyes of this formation. Without them, the Sentinels will be easy picks."

Then, he turned to Claire. "Your team waits until the Sentinels are distracted. Once they break formation, you strike hard and fast. Terrence, you’ll lead the push. Don’t hesitate to use all our ammunition."
Soon, they looked at the A-Grade Sentinel beside Kai.
"And Atom?" Terrence asked with a smile. He already knew what it had to do.
Kai looked at his flawless mech, standing silently.
"Atom will engage the Tyrant directly. It’s the only one that can withstand that cannon. While Atom keeps it busy, we’ll dismantle the escorts."
The survivors exchanged glances. It was a dangerous plan, but it was the only way.
Kai’s heart beat faster as he watched the Spyders slowly showing themselves with their long-barreled weapons angling outward.
Then, one of them paused with its optics glowing brighter... It was scanning the ruins in their direction!
’Shit...’
The silence stretched for some time, but then, the Spyder let out a piercing mechanical screech! It seemed to be giving some signal, or perhaps, it was breaking any signal jammer.
Just like that, the Sentinels immediately adjusted formation with their rifles raised.
Kai clenched his fist...
’We’ve been marked.’
"Ralph!" he called.
Ralph didn’t hesitate as soon as he heard the signal!
"Team A, suppress the Spyders! Move!"
Ten revolvers snapped up at once.
Ralph’s ranged unit broke from cover and spread out along the collapsed highway as they aimed at their targets.
Then, the first volley thundered across the ruins!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Bullets slammed into the rubble where the Spyders were stationed...
To their surprise, the machines actually ducked back behind cover!
"Hmm?"
Kai watched as shards of stone and dust flew as their preemptive attack was avoided. However, it was alright as it gave them information...
’What? Is their armor weaker than I thought?’ Kai paused, remembering how the Sentinels had stood firm against the gunfire without even trying to dodge.
However, it seemed that the Spyder Rangers weren’t as impressive as them.
Still, these units answered immediately. Their long‐barreled rifles lit up, firing precise beams of energy!
One shot scorched the pavement inches from Ralph’s boots, leaving a glowing scar in the concrete. Another beam clipped a survivor’s shoulder, spinning him to the ground with a cry of pain.
"Keep firing! Pin them down!" Ralph shouted.
His team obeyed, laying down continuous fire.
Meanwhile, Claire crouched with her close‐combat squad, waiting...
The Sentinels had tightened their circle around the Tyrant as they moved towards their location...
Apparently, they were moving slowly, matching the speed of the Field Tyrant instead of just charging forward on their spot.
Thankfully, that didn’t last long... As soon as Team A’s gunshots grew heavier and one of the Spyder Ranger units was almost destroyed, their formation shifted.
Two Sentinels broke off, advancing toward Ralph’s position to silence the ranged unit.
Claire smiled as she saw this. Of course, she waited until they got closer before she made her move...
"That’s our cue. Team B, with me!"
Her squad rushed forward from cover while Terrence led the charge.
Clang! Clang!
The clash was immediate as they didn’t want the two Sentinels to have a good position to shoot Ralph’s group. Furthermore, being closer to them would make the A.I. unable to shoot their own kind!
Terrence swung hard, smashing into a Sentinel’s arm and knocking its rifle aside.
Claire then followed with a strike on her own, driving her blade into the Sentinel’s chest plate!
It was not destroyed as she didn’t get the familiar notification, but it was definitely on the verge of shutting down!
"Do not get out of the formation! Stay!" Claire shouted.
The other Sentinels tried to retaliate, but the sudden assault broke their formation. The circle of Sentinels around the Tyrant was finally gone.
In the meantime, Kai just watched the battlefield unfold as planned.
Soon, as the enemy unit was about to cause trouble, Kai made his move...
"Atom. It’s your turn now..."
The flawless mech beside him stepped forward... Soon, its sensors locked onto the Field Tyrant.
Perhaps, it sensed Atom’s presence as it turned towards the unit.
Then, Atom moved.
The ground shook as the A‐Grade Sentinel rushed forward, closing the distance in seconds.
The Field Tyrant raised its cannon and fired at the small threat that was approaching its range.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Just like that, a blinding beam tore through the ruins, blowing apart a section of collapsed highway...
At the very least, it seemed that someone would take care of the mess he made.
Atom didn’t stop. Its shield arm absorbed the blast, glowing white-hot from the impact. With a surge of power, Atom slammed into the Tyrant!
Still, the survivors gasped as the two imbalanced units were actually holding swords!
"Atom’s holding it!" Terrence shouted, with awe in his voice.
Kai’s eyes stayed on this fight...
’Good. Keep it busy. The rest depends on us.’
Ralph’s team kept firing at the Spyders. One of the machines tried to reposition, leaping across rubble, but Ralph’s marksmen tracked it. A volley hit its leg, severing the joint.
Then, more suppressive fire was shot, and soon, the Spyder Ranger collapsed!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Spyder Ranger (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +400 Experience Points ]
"First one down!" Ralph yelled.

Then, Claire’s squad pushed harder against the Sentinels. Terrence drove his blade through another unit’s chest, pulling it free as the machine fell. Claire also fought back and even gave a decisive slash that cut off a Sentinel’s arm.
But the enemies weren’t so easy this time!
For the first time, the Sentinel stopped using rifles or blades and used stun grenades and other cheap tricks that they learned from other humans.

It was scanning the ruins in their direction!
’Shit...’
The silence stretched for some time, but then, the Spyder let out a piercing mechanical screech!
It seemed to be giving some signal, or perhaps, it was breaking any signal jammer.
Just like that, the Sentinels immediately adjusted formation with their rifles raised.
Kai clenched his fist...
’We’ve been marked.’
"Ralph!" he called.
Ralph didn’t hesitate as soon as he heard the signal!
"Team A, suppress the Spyders!
Move!"
Ten revolvers snapped up at once.
Ralph’s ranged unit broke from cover and spread out along the collapsed highway as they aimed at their targets.
Then, the first volley thundered across the ruins!
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Bullets slammed into the rubble where the Spyders were stationed...
To their surprise, the machines actually ducked back behind cover!
"Hmm?"
Kai watched as shards of stone and dust flew as their preemptive attack was avoided.
However, it was alright as it gave them information...
’What?
Is their armor weaker than I thought?’ Kai paused, remembering how the Sentinels had stood firm against the gunfire without even trying to dodge.
However, it seemed that the Spyder Rangers weren’t as impressive as them.
Still, these units answered immediately.
Their long‐barreled rifles lit up, firing precise beams of energy!
One shot scorched the pavement inches from Ralph’s boots, leaving a glowing scar in the concrete.
Another beam clipped a survivor’s shoulder, spinning him to the ground with a cry of pain.
"Keep firing!
Pin them down!" Ralph shouted.
His team obeyed, laying down continuous fire.
Meanwhile, Claire crouched with her close‐combat squad, waiting...
The Sentinels had tightened their circle around the Tyrant as they moved towards their location...
Apparently, they were moving slowly, matching the speed of the Field Tyrant instead of just charging forward on their spot.
Thankfully, that didn’t last long...
As soon as Team A’s gunshots grew heavier and one of the Spyder Ranger units was almost destroyed, their formation shifted.
Two Sentinels broke off, advancing toward Ralph’s position to silence the ranged unit.
Claire smiled as she saw this.
Of course, she waited until they got closer before she made her move...
"That’s our cue.
Team B, with me!"
Her squad rushed forward from cover while Terrence led the charge.
Clang!
Clang!
The clash was immediate as they didn’t want the two Sentinels to have a good position to shoot Ralph’s group.
Furthermore, being closer to them would make the A.I. unable to shoot their own kind!
Terrence swung hard, smashing into a Sentinel’s arm and knocking its rifle aside.
Claire then followed with a strike on her own, driving her blade into the Sentinel’s chest plate!
It was not destroyed as she didn’t get the familiar notification, but it was definitely on the verge of shutting down!
"Do not get out of the formation!
Stay!" Claire shouted.
The other Sentinels tried to retaliate, but the sudden assault broke their formation.
The circle of Sentinels around the Tyrant was finally gone.
In the meantime, Kai just watched the battlefield unfold as planned.
Soon, as the enemy unit was about to cause trouble, Kai made his move...
"Atom.
It’s your turn now..."
The flawless mech beside him stepped forward...
Soon, its sensors locked onto the Field Tyrant.
Perhaps, it sensed Atom’s presence as it turned towards the unit.
Then, Atom moved.
The ground shook as the A‐Grade Sentinel rushed forward, closing the distance in seconds.
The Field Tyrant raised its cannon and fired at the small threat that was approaching its range.
Boom!
Boom!
Boom!
Just like that, a blinding beam tore through the ruins, blowing apart a section of collapsed highway...
At the very least, it seemed that someone would take care of the mess he made.
Atom didn’t stop.
Its shield arm absorbed the blast, glowing white-hot from the impact.
With a surge of power, Atom slammed into the Tyrant!
Still, the survivors gasped as the two imbalanced units were actually holding swords!
"Atom’s holding it!" Terrence shouted, with awe in his voice.
Kai’s eyes stayed on this fight...
’Good.
Keep it busy.
The rest depends on us.’
Ralph’s team kept firing at the Spyders.
One of the machines tried to reposition, leaping across rubble, but Ralph’s marksmen tracked it.
A volley hit its leg, severing the joint.
Then, more suppressive fire was shot, and soon, the Spyder Ranger collapsed!
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Spyder Ranger (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +400 Experience Points ]
"First one down!" Ralph yelled.
Then, Claire’s squad pushed harder against the Sentinels.
Terrence drove his blade through another unit’s chest, pulling it free as the machine fell.
Claire also fought back and even gave a decisive slash that cut off a Sentinel’s arm.
But the enemies weren’t so easy this time!
For the first time, the Sentinel stopped using rifles or blades and used stun grenades and other cheap tricks that they learned from other humans.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Field Tyrant Hunt (Part 1)
paragraphs: The stun grenades went off with bright flashes and a deafening sound.
Several survivors, those who only had a few golden liquids in their bodies, were stunned, blinded, and disoriented by that move...
"Shit... Take cover! Back away!" Claire cursed as one of her fighters dropped his weapon while clutching his ears.
The Sentinels didn’t waste the opening. They moved in with tactics that felt disturbingly human.
One Sentinel kicked debris toward the survivors, forcing them to stumble back! It was then copied by the others...
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Then, another used suppressive fire! Because the sentinel was unstable as well due to the ground, it didn’t hit anyone, but it was enough to pin the remaining fighters down behind cover.
"Stay sharp! They’re trying to box us in!" Claire shouted, forcing her squad to regroup.
She also didn’t expect that the Survivors like them, who had a high enough level, could actually help endure the stun flashes of the grenade just now.
It was a nice perk she didn’t expect she had... It seemed that Level 7 and above Survivors could tolerate that much.
Still, there was no time to celebrate that...
A Sentinel suddenly tossed a smoke canister into the area!
Whoosh~
Thick gray clouds spread quickly, cutting visibility.
From inside the haze came the sound of shifting metal and heavy footsteps.
Thud... Thud... Thud...
"Now they’re using smoke grenades on us? They must have better sensors! These guys weren’t D-Grade! They might be C-Grade Sentinels or something." Ralph said.
None of them expected that Sentinels would be carrying stun grenades and smoke grenades at all!
They thought that they would only carry plasma rifles, normal firearms, or bladed weapons!
Terrence frowned as he felt that they weren’t doing well against the enemies at all.
"They’re masking their movements..."
Thankfully, Ralph’s sharpshooter focus was so helpful... With his almost 100% accuracy with his gun, he was able to damage the enemy guns in their hands!
Even if Ralph’s revolvers weren’t strong enough to penetrate the armor of the Sentinels, it was strong enough to deal with their weapons!
Suddenly, a Sentinel came out of the smoke and charged low, tackling one of Claire’s fighters to the ground.
Instead of finishing him immediately, it tried to drag him back, using him as a living shield against incoming fire.
"Damn it! They’re using hostages now!" Claire snapped, her blade moved swiftly as she cut the machine’s arm away before it could pull the survivor off!
’Seriously... These things are programmed to fight like humans or something...’
Another Sentinel hurled a flashbang into Ralph’s position.
The explosion of light and sound forced his marksmen to duck, breaking their firing rhythm. Immediately, two Sentinels advanced, firing short bursts to keep the squad pinned!
Unfortunately, some of them still had weapons, as Ralph failed to disable or damage all of them!
Ralph gritted his teeth. "They’re coordinating really well..."
One Sentinel deliberately fired into the ground near the survivors, kicking up dust and shards to obscure their aim!
Another used ricochet shots, bouncing rounds off metal surfaces to strike fighters behind cover...
Kai’s eyes narrowed as he watched.
They were truly A.I. Soldiers for a reason!
Their calculations, combat skills, and terrain usage were impeccable! The survivors struggled against this kind of Sentinel’s combat style.
What had been a supposed straightforward clash was now a chaotic fight against machines that fought using every trick to disrupt human reflexes...
"Fine! I’ll deal with them!" Claire said as she truly had no other choice but to ask for help once again!
Spirit Possession!
That was her only choice at the moment... Still, Kai didn’t stop her since it was a good choice.
"Hold formation!" he shouted. "Don’t let them scatter you! Support Claire at all costs!"
The survivors immediately understood the plan as they knew about Claire’s special ability...
Of course, this was only possible thanks to Atom, who was dealing with the Field Tyrant right now!
Currently, the Field Tyrant’s furnace glowed brighter with its vents spewing heat as its claw was aimed at Atom...
It had already consumed a couple of folded cars, and the power surging through its frame was undeniable.
Atom stood firm as it locked on the towering machine. It had just avoided a powerful beam of light that came from its cannon.
Nonetheless, unlike the survivors, it showed no hesitation. Its shield arm was scorched from the earlier blast, but its systems remained stable.
Kai’s eyes also turned to Atom’s direction...
This mysterious Sentinel that he had activated was the key to their victory!
’Atom... You have to prove why you’re different.’
The Tyrant raised its cannon again, with its energy building in its barrel.
Atom didn’t wait as it lifted a bulky rifle that Kai had previously seen in the workshop. This rifle wasn’t a human weapon with how heavy it was, but it was definitely perfect for Sentinels.

This wasn’t a plasma weapon, nor a conventional firearm. The rifle was designed to fire solid blocks of special metal... each one as thick as a human arm. It carried only six rounds, but each shot had the force of a battering ram!
Atom braced for the impact as its hydraulics locked into place.
Clank...
Suddenly, the first block of metal was fired.
BOOM!
The projectile tore through the air, smashing into the Tyrant’s shoulder. The impact was so vicious, denting its armor and forcing the massive machine to stagger sideways!
’It’s working!’Kai’s eyes lit up after seeing this.
He was actually planning to order a retreat if that rifle failed to even dent the Field Tyrant!
However, it seemed that this wasn’t an impossible mission anymore!
Sparks erupted as the joint strained under the blow.
The survivors gasped. Even the Sentinels paused for a moment, their formation faltering at the sight of the Tyrant being forced back.
The Tyrant roared, furnace flaring as if in anger. Its claw swung wide, trying to crush Atom, but Atom sidestepped, shield raised to deflect the strike.
Kai clenched his fists.Five shots left. Make them count.
It didn’t end there as Atom fired again.
BOOM!
The second block slammed into the Tyrant’s chest, right near the furnace cavity!
The armor buckled, and it was already bending inward.
The glow inside seemed to have wavered, but the machine refused to fall.
Instead, it shoved forward, aiming to catch Atom with its claw!

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Field Tyrant Hunt (Part 2)
paragraphs: Atom didn’t fire his gun this time and swiftly dodged instead.
Thud!
The mechanical claw caught nothing but air!
Since Atom was smaller, it would be easier to evade such a large claw, but it couldn’t just dodge repeatedly, or it would just waste its energy...
Atom had to counterattack too!
Crank... Crank...
Seeing that the small enemy was hard to catch, the Field Tyrant actually changed it strategy...
Its cannon hummed again, charging for another blast. Thankfully, this action takes some time, so Atom didn’t give it a chance.
BOOM!
The third shot ripped into the cannon’s housing.
Metal shrieked as the weapon’s casing split!
The mounted cannon seemed to have been badly damaged and couldn’t fire again! It was actually crippled!
Kai’s heart pounded as he saw this...
’Yes... Atom’s rifle is too strong. This is our chance...’He thought for a moment.
Unfortunately, it was wishful thinking!
The moment that the cannon was damaged, the Field Tyrant released something from its lower torso!
It was a wire anchor and it seemed to have a claw at its tip, aiming to catch Atom... and it actually worked!
Atom failed to completely dodge and was grazed by the cable-launched claw hook...
Boom!
The ground where Atom was previously standing shattered from the impact!

But the Tyrant wasn’t finished. It reached down, clawing at the wreckage around it. With terrifying strength, it crushed another car into a cube and shoved it into its furnace. The glow inside flared violently... Its vents then started blasting out waves of heat.
The machine’s movements surged again and this time, it was faster and stronger. The damage Atom had inflicted was being countered by raw energy!

"Damn it... It’s feeding itself during battle!" Kai cursed before he turned his attention back to the remaining Sentinels. He had to quickly deal with the escorts so they could all help Atom against the Field Tyrant!
Kai could only trust that Atom could hold out much longer!
Just like that, Atom steadied its stance and lifted the rifle in its hand. There are three rounds left, and Atom must be careful about it.
The Field Tyrant finally advanced with its claw sweeping low across the ground.
Atom raised its shield to block, but the impact forced the mech backward...
Kai then swiftly gave his command. "Atom, target the joints! Take out its legs!"
Atom adjusted immediately.
BOOM!
The fourth block of metal slammed into the Tyrant’s knee.
The armor shattered, and fragments could be seen scattering as the joint gave way!
Finally, the massive machine limped as its one leg bent under its own weight.
Still, the Tyrant swung its claw again to catch Atom!
However, the A-Grade Sentinel just ducked low then fired the fifth shot.
BOOM!
The block smashed into the claw, tearing through its plating. The gears snapped, and the fingers twisted uselessly!
The Tyrant’s weaponized hand hung broken... One could even see sparks spilling from the damage!
There was one shot left from Atom’s rifle, and this last move must eliminate this Field Boss or at the very least, heavily injure it!
The Tyrant continued to attack with its furnace glowing like molten fire.
However, Atom fired.
BOOM!
This time, the final block of metal struck the furnace directly!
The impact ripped through the thin armor protecting the core of the furnace, and soon, they all heard some gears snapping from the inside of the Field Tyrant!
The Tyrant then froze for a moment as its systems struggled to contain the damage.
Then finally, the furnace erupted!
Flames burst from its vents, and in just a few moments, smoke started pouring out as the machine reeled backward...
At this point, Atom lowered its rifle and just watched as the Field Tyrant was destroyed from the inside!
While this was all happening, the Assault Teams were already finishing the Sentinel Escorts...
However, for the two remaining Spyder Rangers from afar, they were being handled by two Survivors with Gene Weapons, Althea and Sera!
The two of them had already rushed with their camouflage suits the moment Atom and the Field Tyrant faced each other...
It didn’t take that long before their eyes locked on the two remaining Spyders perched among the rubble.
The machines’ long-barreled rifles glowed faintly as they scanned for targets... They were obviously unaware of the hunters closing in.
Soon, Althea and Sera opened their hands, and short metallic blades manifested... They looked simple, but they were sharp and deadly, each about two feet long.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
At this time, the Spyders shot a suppressive fire to help the Sentinel Escorts while also being shot at by the Assault Team!
It was a perfect opportunity for both Atlhea and Sera!
However, as soon as they reached a specific range from the Spyder, which was about 50 meters, the mechanical units immediately turned in their direction!
Suddenly, the Spyders adjusted their optics...
But they were too slow!

Althea charged forward first. She threw a couple of hatchets to buy some, and soon, her Gene Weapon slashed through the rifle of the nearest Spyder. Before the machine could react, she drove the weapon straight into its core.
These Spyder Units had serious damage output, but it was weak in close combat for sure! It had a very thin armor... or perhaps, their Gene Weapon was simply too sharp!
[ Enemy Units Destroyed: Spyder Ranger (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +600 Experience Points ]
It was only D-Grade but it gave a lot of experience!
Anyway, Althea had no time to celebrate as she was worried about Sera...
However, she was worrying for nothing!
Sera followed without hesitation.

She dashed forward and struck her blade, cutting deep into the second Spyder’s chest. The machine convulsed as its circuit board seemed to have been damaged, but Sera pressed in and finished it with a decisive slash that severed its systems.
Thud!
Just like that, the second Spyder fell...
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Spyder Ranger (D) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +400 Experience Points ]
It gave fewer experience points this time, and they could only guess that it was shared by several more members from the Assault Team!

Nonetheless, what was most important here was the fact that after the Spyders were eliminated, the Escorts Sentinels had lost their overwatch support. Their coordination weakened, leaving them exposed to Claire’s strikes and Ralph’s suppressive fire.
Still, the most exciting message from the system was the confirmation of the Field Tyrant’s destruction!

chapters.title: Chapter 93: The First Rewards
paragraphs: Kai smiled as soon as he saw the message.
The system’s confirmation of the Field Tyrant’s destruction spread quickly among the teams.
For a moment, the battlefield was filled with shouts of relief and victory.
"We killed a Field Tyrant!" one of the survivors exclaimed.
"Atom is the best! I’ll clean you every day from now on!" another added.
"Hahaha! They’re not as strong as we thought!"
"It’s all thanks to Kai’s control!"
"Our mission is a success!"
Kai raised his hand to steady them. "Calm down, guys... This is a ten-day event! Furthermore, this was only Grade C."
He reminded them after seeing them getting too excited.
"I’m not sure if a higher grade will appear, but during those ten days, it wouldn’t be surprising... Just imagine what B or A will be like. We need to be ready." He said.
Still, he couldn’t hide his satisfaction as he looked at the messages.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Field Tyrant (C) ]
[ Experience Points distributed among all participants. ]
[ +2,400 Experience Points ]
Kai smiled seeing this first message. Although he was quite surprised that it was only Grade C, it was still quite understandable.
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 16 ]
[ Health Points +5 ]
[ Spirit Points +1 ]
[ Physique Rating has slightly improved! ]
"Nice... They’ll be surprised seeing the leaderboard for sure." Kai muttered to himself as he confirmed that he had indeed leveled up.
[ Congratulations! You are the first Survivor to eliminate a Field Tyrant (C). ]
[ Hint: Only the first elimination of each C-Grade and higher unit can provide special rewards! ]
[ You can select one reward: Instant Experience Potion x2, Energy Cores x2, Random Gift Pack x2, Random Weapon Blueprint x2 ]
[ Congratulations! First Enemy Destruction Achieved. ]
[ Reward Granted: Skill Point +1, Survivor’s Medal x1 ]
[ You have obtained 10 Reputation Points. ]
[ Hint: Only Survivors above Level 15 can obtain Reputation Points. ]
Kai’s grin widened as the messages stacked up.
’A Skill Point, a medal, and even reputation points... this is huge.’
He paused at the reward selection screen.
’Experience potions would push me further ahead... but energy cores might be something Atom needed. Weapon blueprints might be even more valuable in the long run...’
They were definitely good choices. However, he dismissed the gift packs immediately for an obvious reason.
Still, he couldn’t decide right away.
’Do I secure my own growth, or invest in gear that could change the tide for everyone?’
At this point, he had already guessed that big rewards only come after every five levels...
In short, his next boost of strength or even chance of getting a new skill would be once he reached Level 20.
Getting another level right now wouldn’t give him the necessary boost that he needed.
For now, his eyes lingered on the Reputation Points.
This was a new feature from the system, and it seemed that he was the first person to get this since only those above Level 15 could obtain it.
’Ten points... what can I even do with these? Trade? Unlock privileges? Maybe they’re tied to the system’s ranking. There’s not even a hint where to use them...’He mused.
Finally, Kai turned his attention to the other notifications he had dismissed for a moment.
It was the notifications about the valuable items they could loot from the enemy units!
[ Tyrant’s Salvageable Loot: Energy Core, Reinforced Claw Assembly, Heavy‐Grade Hydraulic Frame, Adaptive Armor Plating, Siege Cannon Housing ]
[ Spyder’s Salvageable Loot: Precision Optic Scope, Lightweight Exo‐Frame Segment, Energy Cartridge Pack ]
[ Sentinel’s Salvageable Loot: Advanced Cognitive Processor, Hardened Armor Shard, Plasma Rifle Mk.I, Energy Power Cell ]
[ Note: Only high-value salvageable components are listed. Common debris and low‐grade materials are excluded. ]
The Field Tyrant’s drops caught his attention first.
’Energy Core... Adaptive Armor Plating... Siege Cannon Housing.’
He knew these weren’t ordinary scraps, they were rare components that could be repurposed into powerful upgrades.
The Spyder loot was leaner but still useful.
’Precision Optic Scope... perfect for ranged units.’
He immediately thought of Ralph and his team...
Of course, the Sentinel Escort loot was impressive too.Plasma Rifle and even Energy Power Cell!
After all, their New Haven-45 had dozens of Plasma Rifles in their base. However, they lack energy and couldn’t be used in combat!
If they truly obtained several more Energy Power Cells here, then that would be a game-changer!
Kai couldn’t help but grin.
’This is too incredible... This is the foundation for building stronger weapons, stronger defenses... stronger survivors.’

In just a few moments, the survivors around him were already moving, scavenging parts from the wreckage. Claire directed her squad to secure the Sentinel’s cores, while Ralph’s team carefully extracted the Spyder optics.
Althea and Sera also collected the external weapons of the Spyder Units before helping with the dismantling of the unit itself...
Kai was about to join the dismantling effort when he noticed Atom suddenly moving again... without any command!
"Hmm? What are you planning to do this time, Atom?" He muttered, but he didn’t stop the machine at all.
The A‐Grade Sentinel strode past the scavenging Survivors.
Seeing Atom’s movement, the Survivors paused, watching in confusion as the A-Grade Sentinel approached the ruined body of the Field Tyrant.
The furnace was still glowing faintly with its vents hissing with residual heat.
Yet Atom ignored the waves of scorching air. It just moved forward without hesitation.
Then, to everyone’s shock, Atom climbed directly into the Tyrant’s broken frame.
Crank... Crank...
Metal screeched as the smaller mech unit forced its way inside, heading straight toward the furnace core.
"What is it doing?" Claire muttered as he turned to Kai.
However, the latter just shrugged. Kai had no clue, but based on what had happened before, he could only guess that Atom would be targeting something unusual, like that black iron ball before...
"Is it... absorbing something?" Ralph muttered as he observed the Mech Units.
No one knew what was happening inside.
The heat should have melted circuits, but Atom seemed unaffected as they could still hear the mech moving inside!
For several tense moments, the survivors could only wait, listening to the faint groans of metal from within the Tyrant’s body.
Then, suddenly, Atom emerged.

chapters.title: Chapter 94: The Updated Leaderboard
paragraphs: Atom’s movements remained steady and almost lifelike just like before.
Kai studied it carefully, searching for any obvious changes. At first, nothing seemed different.
Yet for some reason, he felt it. Atom carried itself with a new confidence, as if something inside had shifted.
Its optics, those dull mechanical "eyes," now glowed a little brighter than before.
’Did we just solve the energy problem?’ Kai wondered. This was the problem that had been gnawing in his mind for several days already.
After all, he had no idea whether Atom would just suddenly run out of power!
Thankfully, the brighter glow in its eyes was probably an indication that it had charged up or something.
Without a word, Atom turned away from the wreckage and walked calmly out of the scene, leaving the furnace behind.
Kai felt a little more excited.
’It ignored the heat... went straight into the core... and came back stronger. I think I understand it now.’
The survivors exchanged bewildered looks, but all of them were happy with the fact that Atom was their ally!
"Whatever happened in there... Atom is still with us. And it’s stronger now." Kai reminded everyone with a laugh.
Just like that, everyone celebrated as they continued salvaging whatever items they could find... Nothing must be wasted from this mechanical unit!
On the other hand, after a few minutes, Kai finally selected Energy Cores for the rewards option. He needed tangible rewards in these early stages of the Apocalypse after all.

Although he liked the Weapon Blueprint as it could help them in the future, he believed that it would still require a lot of other resources, like proper equipment, materials, even craftsmen or experts who could truly create them.
Then, as Kai was about to gather the bladed weapons of the Sentinels to help clean up the place, he heard Claire’s voice from behind.
"Kai! Look, you’re not the only one in the Leaderboard anymore!" Claire said as she urged Kai to check the system’s Leaderboard.
As soon as he heard this, Kai nodded and quickly checked the system’s Leaderboard.
[ Top Survivor Ranking List ]
[ 1. Kai - Level 16 ]
[ 2. Renji - Level 10 ]
[ 3. Mei - Level 10 ]
[ 4. Arjun - Level 10 ]
"Oh... You’re right! There are three more." Kai muttered as he saw the updated rankings in the Leaderboard.
It seemed that these three had just found something that made them level up big time. Perhaps, they also defeated their own Field Tyrant just now.
In any case, similar to him, only their first names could be seen...
As soon as he saw Mei’s name, he couldn’t help but recall someone in his office. However, Mei was a common name, so he wasn’t expecting that it was someone he knew.
Not too far from Haven-11, the shelter that was already being occupied by some perverted Survivors, Mei was still searching for food...
She had never imagined she would survive this long. When the Global Event to hunt Field Tyrants was announced to everyone, she was only Level 6, barely strong enough to fend off ordinary Sentinels.
The announcement alone made her truly fear for her life...
"Only ten days before a new event, huh..." Mei muttered.
She remembered the predators she had fled from before, humans who had turned into opportunistic hunters after the first Mech Siege.
If she could barely escape them, how could she possibly stand against a Field Tyrant?
Her talent, Living Camouflage, had saved her countless times.
By merging with trees or blending into rubble, she could vanish from sight, waiting for danger to pass.
But hiding was not enough anymore.
The Event demanded kills, and although the system would reward those who simply survived, it would not be any exceptional reward.
Mei prayed quietly, asking for strength, and hoped that she’d be able to endure this Apocalypse.
Then, just three days before the Global Event to hunt Field Tyrant started, fortune shifted.
While fleeing from a patrol of Sentinels, Mei stumbled upon a collapsed structure hidden deep in the forest.
At first, she thought it was just another ruin. But as she explored, she realized it was a laboratory.
The walls were scorched, skeletons lay scattered across the floor, and shattered equipment hinted at experiments that were long abandoned. She even found three industrial demolition explosives!
Although she had no idea how to use it yet, she knew that she could learn it if she studied it carefully.
In any case, despite the eerie silence, the laboratory became her refuge.
She fortified the entrance, set traps, and claimed it as her base.
It was safer than wandering aimlessly, and it gave her a chance to breathe.
More importantly, she found treasures among the remains!
The skeletons carried vials of Alpha Gene Enhancement Serums, still intact despite the years.

She was actually worried that they were already expired at first, but thankfully, the Apocalypse System didn’t let her down and confirmed that they were alright to consume, and there would only be some degradation in their effects instead.

After using the serums, she immediately felt her body surge with new vitality. Her physique started improving, and her senses heightened. Although her camouflage ability was still the same, she somehow felt that it had become more seamless than ever.
There was no system notification about the improvement of her talent, so it was probably just in her mind, but still, she knew that she had become a lot better.
With each serum, her confidence grew.
She also scavenged weapons from broken crates, pieced together armor from discarded fragments, and slowly built herself into a fighter.
When the event arrived, she was already a Level 9 Survivor...
On the day of the Global Event, Mei realized how lucky she was!
"Do I have a hidden Luck Stat or something? Why am I so lucky?" Mei said as her chance came when she spotted a Field Tyrant wandering not too far from a cliff...
The massive machine was terrifying, with its furnace that could probably burn anything it touches... However, it wasn’t as agile as it seemed.
’This is possible, right?’
Mei knew she could never defeat it head-on. But the laboratory had given her tools, and her talent gave her patience...
After considering all of this, Mei took a deep breath as she devised a plan...
’Maybe if I reach Level 10 quickly, Kai will notice my name... If there’s a chance later or if there’s any system update, we might even be able to contact each other.’

chapters.title: Chapter 95: The Visitors
paragraphs: Mei knew that if Kai, who was in the leaderboard, were really her reliable officemate, he’d also get curious if he saw her name in the list. Perhaps, they could have a chance of meeting each other...
However, for that to happen, she needed to reach level 10 as quickly as possible. Furthermore, she had to maintain it and ensure she remained in the Top 20, even if not the Top 3.
After all, only those in the Top 20 would be given rewards.
She’d be more noticeable if she were a higher rank for sure.
In any case, Mei knew really well that using her camouflage to her advantage would only be her way to beat this Global Event.
After careful planning, she lured the Tyrant toward a gorge where the ground was unstable.
She did this carefully since the Tyrant was accompanied by some Sentinels and protected by a few Spyder Rangers from afar...

"Just be patient..." Mei reminded herself as she baited them with noise and movement, vanishing into the trees whenever they tried to strike. Of course, she used all the tools she found in the laboratory to make this happen.
Furthermore, what truly helped her in this operation was the fact that their Sensors weren’t as impressive as the Hounds she had seen before.
Thanks to that, she was able to go according to her plan...
The A.I. army soon grewfrustrated, if that was the right term, as they started smashing through obstacles while chasing her traces!
Finally, the Field Tyrant stepped onto the weakened ground, and it was followed by the Sentinels!
Crack!
The trap worked!
The earth had soon collapsed beneath the Tyrant’s weight, sending it crashing into the canyon. Mei had already prepared explosives scavenged from the laboratory.
She triggered them, and the blast tore into the Tyrant’s exposed furnace!
Boom!
Soon, she saw the machine trying to get out or move away, but its vents started spewing fire!
Then, there was a second explosion that came from the Field Tyrant itself!
This time, it was actually a lot stronger to the point that Mei believed that she would not be able to loot anything at all!
Then, soon, the system messages flooded her vision.
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Field Tyrant (C) ]
[ +8,000 Experience Points ]
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (D) ]
[ +1,000 Experience Points ]
[ Enemy Unit Destroyed: Sentinel (D) ]
[ +1,000 Experience Points ]
Then, she had indeed leveled up!
[ You have leveled up! ]
[ Level: 10 ]
[ Health Points +100 ]
[ Spirit Points +2 ]
[ Physique Rating has improved! ]
[ Inventory Slots Expanded: +1 ]
"Finally!" Mei clenched her fist in excitement as she read through the messages.
[ Congratulations! You have entered the Leaderboard! ]
[ Current Rank: #3 ]
[ Congratulations! You are the third survivor to reach Level 10. ]
[ Reminder: Rankings will be recalculated every 30 days. ]
[ Maintain your position for 30 consecutive days to receive an Exclusive Reward. ]
Mei felt extremely excited...
She had done it. Against all odds, she had defeated a Field Tyrant alone!
Although she used a trick, it was something that others could never copy because of the terrain and timing. She had achieved something incredible!
The victory was more than just numbers. It was proof that she could fight, that she could carve her place in this brutal world.
’Living Camauflage... I knew it. This isn’t just for escaping.’ Mei thought as she soon, she felt something off.
She had a Gene Skill called Full Sense... It allowed her camouflage talent to become more difficult to detect, but it also enhanced her senses...
’Shit... The Spyders are still active!’ Mei recalled and looked around.
Then suddenly, she saw a flash of light! Her Full Sense was triggered, so she swiftly moved away!
Boom!
Her previous position was obliterated by a beam of light. The ground where she had stood moments earlier was scorched black!
"Alright... time to move," Mei whispered as she calculated the angle of attack...

Soon, she sprinted toward cover, moving through the terrain to break the Spyders’ line of sight. Using her camouflage, she blended into the rocks and trees, vanishing from any of their angle of attack.
Thankfully, she had already leveled up, and she had full Spirit Points once again.
"Please don’t just shoot blindly..."
For now, she could only pray that they wouldn’t do something stupid like firing in her specific direction to force her out.
That would be a disaster!
Then, after several minutes of silence, Mei could finally smile a little.
She had still succeeded in her mission!
Although the Spyders were still around the area, she was already satisfied with the fact that she had reached Level 10!
As soon as Kai and the others finished salvaging the wreckage, they wasted no time retreating back to their stronghold, New Haven‐45.
The haul was heavy, but they were all satisfied with their work.
Everyone was eager to return, hoping for rest and perhaps even a surprise encounter with the elusive Gene Trader.
Kai himself had some anticipation. The system had hinted that the Gene Traders could appear randomly, and he prayed this would be their lucky day.
But when the gates of New Haven‐45 came into view, his hope quickly soured.
The perimeter alarms were already activated, the basic wires they set up had already been cut off, and some simple traps had also been triggered.
Then, they heard the survivors on watch were shouting in panic!
Various figures moved, attempting to scale the walls... However, what was surprising was the fact that they were not Sentinels, not Spyders, but something far more unsettling.
Kai frowned at the sight...
Although they were lucky that the siege had just started and they arrived in time, he was also confused by what he was seeing!
These weren’t machines. They were human... or at least they had been.
They still looked human at first glance with two arms, two legs, and a head... but something was clearly wrong. Their bodies had changed in unnatural ways.
Their limbs were uneven, their features distorted, their movements stiff and strange!
It was like they were seeing undead creatures instead!
